nvarchar(20))))`。 3. 💰 即時行情來源鐵律： - [MasterStockAnalysis] 只有 `盤中現價`、`盤中總量`、`專家實戰總分`、`產業分類`，【絕對沒有 成交價 與 漲幅】！ - 需要標準行情時，必須串聯：`LEFT JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(主表.代號))` 抓取 `B.成交價 AS 現價, B.漲幅 AS [今日漲幅%], B.總量 AS [成交量(張)], B.股本億 AS [股本(億)]`。 4. 🛡️ 笛卡兒積防爆與多對一鎖定： - `value` 每日評價表必帶 `AND V.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM value)` (防 2500 倍膨脹)。 - `financesum` 財報季表必用 `ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn ... rn=1` (取每檔最新一季)。 - `allcross_live` 金叉數據必用 `ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY 代號 ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn ... rn=1` (徹底消滅全 0 與 NULL)。 - 一字漲跌停防衛：除法必用 `NULLIF(最高 - 最低, 0)`，收盤位置% 加 `ISNULL(..., 100.0)`。 - 勝率百分比防呆：`CASE WHEN WinRate <= 1.0 THEN WinRate * 100.0 ELSE WinRate END` (防 5240% 膨脹)。 【六、核心資料表欄位清單】 ● stockchange.dbo.basicinfo: 代號, python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.0】99 母艦量化範本核武發射艙
檔案名稱：quant_master_launcher.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\quant_master_launcher.py
核心功能：
  1. 連接 [stockchangedate].[dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] 與 [sp_RunQuantTemplate]
  2. 整合 Flet 99 母艦 UI (支援獨立開啟或內嵌於 master_cockpit.py)
  3. 一鍵執行選股、動態更新使用統計、格式化戰報
  4. 🚀 一鍵火控發射：連線 TG / LINE / zen_broadcaster.py 進行實盤通訊
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import logging
import datetime
import requests
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import flet as ft

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 設定日誌與連線組態
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("QuantLauncher")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "server": "localhost",
    "database": "stockchangedate",
    "driver": "{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}",
    "trusted_connection": "yes"
}

CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={DB_CONFIG['database']};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};TrustServerCertificate=yes;"
LOCAL_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"  # line_ai_bot1 / zen_broadcaster 通訊中樞

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 資料庫操作引擎 (Quant SQL Engine)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class QuantTemplateEngine:
    @staticmethod
    def get_connection():
        return pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_templates(cls):
        """獲取所有啟用的量化範本清單"""
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, TargetDB, SortOrder, UsageCount, LastUsedDate
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                df = pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
                return df
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"讀取 QuantSqlTemplates 失敗: {e}")
            return pd.DataFrame()

    @classmethod
    def run_template(cls, template_id: int):
        """執行指定編號的量化策略，並更新使用統計"""
        update_sql = """
        UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        SET UsageCount = ISNULL(UsageCount, 0) + 1,
            LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE TemplateID = ?
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                # 1. 取得 SQL
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(update_sql, (template_id,))
                conn.commit()

                cursor.execute("SELECT CorrectSQL, Title, StrategyDesc FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE TemplateID = ?", (template_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None, "找不到指定的量化範本 ID！", ""

                raw_sql = row[0]
                title = row[1]
                desc = row[2]

                # 2. 清理 SQL (拔除開頭的註解標記如 /*資料庫:stockchangedate*/)
                clean_sql = raw_sql
                if "/*" in clean_sql and "*/" in clean_sql:
                    clean_sql = clean_sql.split("*/", 1)[-1].strip()

                if not clean_sql.lower().startswith("select"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql

                # 3. 執行選股查詢
                df_result = pd.read_sql(clean_sql, conn)
                return df_result, f"✅ 執行成功！共選出 {len(df_result)} 檔標的。", f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"執行範本 {template_id} 失敗: {e}")
            return None, f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}", ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 火控廣播發射核心 (Broadcast Launcher)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FireControlBroadcaster:
    @staticmethod
    def format_telegram_report(title: str, desc: str, df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> str:
        """將量化結果格式化為戰報文本"""
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        msg = f"👑 <b>【99母艦・核武量化戰報】</b>\n"
        msg += f"🎯 <b>策略</b>：{title}\n"
        msg += f"⏰ <b>時間</b>：{now_str}\n"
        msg += f"📝 <b>核心邏輯</b>：{desc[:100]}...\n"
        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        
        if df.empty:
            msg += "⚠️ 本次掃描無符合標的。\n"
            return msg

        sub_df = df.head(top_n)
        for idx, row in sub_df.iterrows():
            code = str(row.get('代號', '')).strip()
            name = str(row.get('名稱', '')).strip()
            price = row.get('現價', row.get('成交價', '-'))
            vol = row.get('成交量(張)', '-')
            pe = row.get('本益比', '-')
            roe = row.get('ROE%', '-')
            tag = row.get('價值成長標籤', row.get('空間判定', ''))

            msg += f"<b>{idx+1}. {code} {name}</b> | 現價: <code>{price}</code>\n"
            detail_line = []
            if pe != '-': detail_line.append(f"PE: {pe}")
            if roe != '-': detail_line.append(f"ROE: {roe}%")
            if vol != '-': detail_line.append(f"量: {vol}張")
            if detail_line:
                msg += f"   └ " + " | ".join(detail_line) + "\n"
            if tag:
                msg += f"   └ 🏷️ <i>{tag}</i>\n"

        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        msg += f"📊 完整選出 {len(df)} 檔，請登入戰情室大屏查閱全譜系。"
        return msg

    @classmethod
    def launch_broadcast(cls, message: str) -> bool:
        """調用本地通訊中樞發射至 Telegram / LINE"""
        try:
            # 調用本機 line_ai_bot1 / zen_broadcaster 的 API
            payload = {"message": message, "target": "all"}
            res = requests.post(f"{LOCAL_API_URL}/push_data_to_tg", json=payload, timeout=5)
            return res.status_code == 200
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"發射至通訊中樞失敗（可能未啟動 Port 5000）: {e}")
            return False

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 99 母艦 Flet UI 體驗視窗
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙 V16.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.padding = 20
    page.window_width = 1400
    page.window_height = 900
    page.bgcolor = "#0B0E14"

    current_df = [None]
    current_template_meta = {"title": "", "desc": ""}

    # 1. 頂部狀態列
    status_text = ft.Text("系統就緒・請選取量化策略範本", color="#64748B", size=13)
    
    # 2. 策略選擇器
    templates_df = QuantTemplateEngine.get_all_templates()
    dropdown_options = []
    if not templates_df.empty:
        for _, row in templates_df.iterrows():
            dropdown_options.append(
                ft.dropdown.Option(
                    key=str(row['TemplateID']),
                    text=f"[{row['Category']}] {row['Title']} (已跑 {row['UsageCount']} 次)"
                )
            )

    template_dropdown = ft.Dropdown(
        label="🎯 選擇量化核武庫策略範本 (QuantSqlTemplates)",
        hint_text="請挑選預載策略...",
        options=dropdown_options,
        width=600,
        bgcolor="#1E293B",
        border_color="#3B82F6",
        color="#F8FAFC"
    )

    strategy_desc_card = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([
            ft.Text("📌 策略戰略解說：", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38BDF8"),
            ft.Text("尚未載入策略...", size=13, color="#94A3B8", id="desc_content")
        ]),
        bgcolor="#111827",
        padding=15,
        border_radius=8,
        border=ft.border.all(1, "#1F2937"),
        width=1340
    )

    # 3. 資料顯示表格容器
    table_container = ft.Column(
        scroll=ft.ScrollMode.ADAPTIVE,
        expand=True,
        controls=[ft.Text("請點擊『⚡ 一鍵光速試算』出表...", color="#475569")]
    )

    # 4. 回調函數：選取範本
    def on_template_change(e):
        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        match = templates_df[templates_df['TemplateID'] == tid]
        if not match.empty:
            title = match.iloc[0]['Title']
            desc = match.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
            current_template_meta["title"] = title
            current_template_meta["desc"] = desc
            strategy_desc_card.content.controls[1].value = f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
            page.update()

    template_dropdown.on_change = on_template_change

    # 5. 回調函數：執行選股
    def run_strategy_click(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先選擇一個量化範本！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        status_text.value = f"⏳ 正在調用動態引擎執行範本 ID: {tid}..."
        status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
        page.update()

        df, msg, _ = QuantTemplateEngine.run_template(tid)
        current_df[0] = df
        status_text.value = msg
        status_text.color = "#10B981" if df is not None else "#EF4444"

        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            # 建立動態 DataTable
            cols = [ft.DataColumn(ft.Text(col, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#93C5FD")) for col in df.columns]
            rows = []
            for _, r in df.head(50).iterrows():
                cells = []
                for val in r:
                    cells.append(ft.DataCell(ft.Text(str(val) if pd.notnull(val) else "-")))
                rows.append(ft.DataRow(cells=cells))

            table_container.controls = [
                ft.DataTable(
                    columns=cols,
                    rows=rows,
                    border=ft.border.all(1, "#334155"),
                    vertical_lines=ft.border.BorderSide(1, "#1E293B"),
                    heading_row_color="#1E293B",
                    data_row_color={"hovered": "#334155"}
                )
            ]
        else:
            table_container.controls = [ft.Text("無資料符合或查詢異常。", color="#EF4444")]

        page.update()

    # 6. 回調函數：一鍵火控發射
    def launch_fire_click(e):
        if current_df[0] is None or current_df[0].empty:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先執行試算並確認選股清單不為空再行發射！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_telegram_report(
            title=current_template_meta["title"],
            desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
            df=current_df[0],
            top_n=5
        )
        
        success = FireControlBroadcaster.launch_broadcast(report)
        if success:
            status_text.value = f"🚀 核武戰報已成功發射至 TG / LINE 陣地中樞！"
            status_text.color = "#10B981"
        else:
            # 降級方案：若未開 API，在控制台與彈窗打印完整戰報以供體驗
            status_text.value = f"📡 本地廣播中樞離線，已在彈窗輸出預覽戰報！"
            status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
            
            def close_dialog(e_dlg):
                dialog.open = False
                page.update()

            dialog = ft.AlertDialog(
                title=ft.Text("🚀 火控發射預覽戰報 (可複製發布)"),
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.TextField(value=report, multiline=True, min_lines=12, max_lines=16, read_only=True),
                    width=600
                ),
                actions=[ft.TextButton("關閉", on_click=close_dialog)],
                actions_alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.END,
            )
            page.dialog = dialog
            dialog.open = True

        page.update()

    # 7. 按鈕控制列
    btn_run = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "⚡ 一鍵光速試算 (Execute)",
        icon=ft.icons.BOLT,
        bgcolor="#2563EB",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=run_strategy_click,
        height=48
    )

    btn_launch = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "🚀 火控發射至四網 (Broadcast)",
        icon=ft.icons.ROCKET_LAUNCH,
        bgcolor="#DC2626",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=launch_fire_click,
        height=48
    )

    controls_bar = ft.Row([
        template_dropdown,
        btn_run,
        btn_launch,
    ], spacing=15)

    # 8. 畫面總裝
    page.add(
        ft.Column([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Text("👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#F8FAFC"),
                ft.Container(expand=True),
                status_text
            ]),
            controls_bar,
            strategy_desc_card,
            ft.Divider(color="#1F2937", height=1),
            table_container
        ], expand=True, spacing=15)
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 支援獨立啟動 Web 模式 (開放體驗，瀏覽器開啟 http://localhost:8552)
    # 若需掛載至 99 母艦主屏，可直接以模組形式引入
    ft.app(target=main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.0】99 母艦量化範本核武發射艙 (Flet 1.0+ 雙軌相容版)
檔案名稱：quant_master_launcher.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\quant_master_launcher.py
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import logging
import datetime
import requests
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import flet as ft

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 設定日誌與連線組態
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("QuantLauncher")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "server": "localhost",
    "database": "stockchangedate",
    "driver": "{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}",
    "trusted_connection": "yes"
}

CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={DB_CONFIG['database']};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};TrustServerCertificate=yes;"
LOCAL_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"  # 通訊中樞 API

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 資料庫操作引擎 (Quant SQL Engine)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class QuantTemplateEngine:
    @staticmethod
    def get_connection():
        return pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_templates(cls):
        """獲取所有啟用的量化範本清單"""
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, TargetDB, SortOrder, UsageCount, LastUsedDate
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                df = pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
                return df
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"讀取 QuantSqlTemplates 失敗: {e}")
            return pd.DataFrame()

    @classmethod
    def run_template(cls, template_id: int):
        """執行指定編號的量化策略，並更新使用統計"""
        update_sql = """
        UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        SET UsageCount = ISNULL(UsageCount, 0) + 1,
            LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE TemplateID = ?
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(update_sql, (template_id,))
                conn.commit()

                cursor.execute("SELECT CorrectSQL, Title, StrategyDesc FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE TemplateID = ?", (template_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None, "找不到指定的量化範本 ID！", ""

                raw_sql = row[0]
                title = row[1]
                desc = row[2]

                # 清理 SQL 前綴註解標記
                clean_sql = raw_sql
                if "/*" in clean_sql and "*/" in clean_sql:
                    clean_sql = clean_sql.split("*/", 1)[-1].strip()

                if not clean_sql.lower().startswith("select"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql

                df_result = pd.read_sql(clean_sql, conn)
                return df_result, f"✅ 執行成功！共選出 {len(df_result)} 檔標的。", f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"執行範本 {template_id} 失敗: {e}")
            return None, f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}", ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 火控廣播發射核心 (Broadcast Launcher)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FireControlBroadcaster:
    @staticmethod
    def format_telegram_report(title: str, desc: str, df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> str:
        """將量化結果格式化為戰報文本"""
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        msg = f"👑 <b>【99母艦・核武量化戰報】</b>\n"
        msg += f"🎯 <b>策略</b>：{title}\n"
        msg += f"⏰ <b>時間</b>：{now_str}\n"
        msg += f"📝 <b>核心邏輯</b>：{desc[:100]}...\n"
        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        
        if df.empty:
            msg += "⚠️ 本次掃描無符合標的。\n"
            return msg

        sub_df = df.head(top_n)
        for idx, row in sub_df.iterrows():
            code = str(row.get('代號', '')).strip()
            name = str(row.get('名稱', '')).strip()
            price = row.get('現價', row.get('成交價', '-'))
            vol = row.get('成交量(張)', '-')
            pe = row.get('本益比', '-')
            roe = row.get('ROE%', '-')
            tag = row.get('價值成長標籤', row.get('空間判定', ''))

            msg += f"<b>{idx+1}. {code} {name}</b> | 現價: <code>{price}</code>\n"
            detail_line = []
            if pe != '-': detail_line.append(f"PE: {pe}")
            if roe != '-': detail_line.append(f"ROE: {roe}%")
            if vol != '-': detail_line.append(f"量: {vol}張")
            if detail_line:
                msg += f"   └ " + " | ".join(detail_line) + "\n"
            if tag:
                msg += f"   └ 🏷️ <i>{tag}</i>\n"

        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        msg += f"📊 完整選出 {len(df)} 檔，請登入戰情室大屏查閱全譜系。"
        return msg

    @classmethod
    def launch_broadcast(cls, message: str) -> bool:
        """調用本地通訊中樞發射至 Telegram / LINE"""
        try:
            payload = {"message": message, "target": "all"}
            res = requests.post(f"{LOCAL_API_URL}/push_data_to_tg", json=payload, timeout=5)
            return res.status_code == 200
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"發射至通訊中樞失敗（可能未啟動 Port 5000）: {e}")
            return False

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 99 母艦 Flet UI 體驗視窗
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙 V16.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.padding = 20
    page.bgcolor = "#0B0E14"

    # 相容設定視窗大小 (Flet 1.0+ 與舊版相容)
    if hasattr(page, "window") and hasattr(page.window, "width"):
        page.window.width = 1400
        page.window.height = 900
    else:
        page.window_width = 1400
        page.window_height = 900

    current_df = [None]
    current_template_meta = {"title": "", "desc": ""}

    # 1. 頂部狀態列
    status_text = ft.Text("系統就緒・請選取量化策略範本", color="#64748B", size=13)
    
    # 2. 策略選擇器
    templates_df = QuantTemplateEngine.get_all_templates()
    dropdown_options = []
    if not templates_df.empty:
        for _, row in templates_df.iterrows():
            dropdown_options.append(
                ft.dropdown.Option(
                    key=str(row['TemplateID']),
                    text=f"[{row['Category']}] {row['Title']} (已跑 {row['UsageCount']} 次)"
                )
            )

    template_dropdown = ft.Dropdown(
        label="🎯 選擇量化核武庫策略範本 (QuantSqlTemplates)",
        hint_text="請挑選預載策略...",
        options=dropdown_options,
        width=600,
        bgcolor="#1E293B",
        border_color="#3B82F6",
        color="#F8FAFC"
    )

    desc_content = ft.Text("尚未載入策略...", size=13, color="#94A3B8")
    strategy_desc_card = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([
            ft.Text("📌 策略戰略解說：", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38BDF8"),
            desc_content
        ]),
        bgcolor="#111827",
        padding=15,
        border_radius=8,
        border=ft.border.all(1, "#1F2937"),
        width=1340
    )

    # 3. 資料顯示表格容器
    table_container = ft.Column(
        scroll=ft.ScrollMode.ADAPTIVE,
        expand=True,
        controls=[ft.Text("請點擊『⚡ 一鍵光速試算』出表...", color="#475569")]
    )

    # 4. 回調函數：選取範本
    def on_template_change(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            return
        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        match = templates_df[templates_df['TemplateID'] == tid]
        if not match.empty:
            title = match.iloc[0]['Title']
            desc = match.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
            current_template_meta["title"] = title
            current_template_meta["desc"] = desc
            desc_content.value = f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
            page.update()

    template_dropdown.on_change = on_template_change

    # 5. 回調函數：執行選股
    def run_strategy_click(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先選擇一個量化範本！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        status_text.value = f"⏳ 正在調用動態引擎執行範本 ID: {tid}..."
        status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
        page.update()

        df, msg, _ = QuantTemplateEngine.run_template(tid)
        current_df[0] = df
        status_text.value = msg
        status_text.color = "#10B981" if df is not None else "#EF4444"

        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            cols = [ft.DataColumn(ft.Text(col, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#93C5FD")) for col in df.columns]
            rows = []
            for _, r in df.head(50).iterrows():
                cells = []
                for val in r:
                    cells.append(ft.DataCell(ft.Text(str(val) if pd.notnull(val) else "-")))
                rows.append(ft.DataRow(cells=cells))

            table_container.controls = [
                ft.DataTable(
                    columns=cols,
                    rows=rows,
                    border=ft.border.all(1, "#334155"),
                    vertical_lines=ft.border.BorderSide(1, "#1E293B"),
                    heading_row_color="#1E293B",
                    data_row_color={"hovered": "#334155"}
                )
            ]
        else:
            table_container.controls = [ft.Text("無資料符合或查詢異常。", color="#EF4444")]

        page.update()

    # 彈窗關閉與開啟 Helper (相容 Flet 1.0 與 0.x)
    def open_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "open"):
            page.open(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "show_dialog"):
            page.show_dialog(dlg)
        else:
            page.dialog = dlg
            dlg.open = True
            page.update()

    def close_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "close"):
            page.close(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "pop_dialog"):
            page.pop_dialog()
        else:
            dlg.open = False
            page.update()

    # 6. 回調函數：一鍵火控發射
    def launch_fire_click(e):
        if current_df[0] is None or current_df[0].empty:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先執行試算並確認選股清單不為空再行發射！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_telegram_report(
            title=current_template_meta["title"],
            desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
            df=current_df[0],
            top_n=5
        )
        
        success = FireControlBroadcaster.launch_broadcast(report)
        if success:
            status_text.value = f"🚀 核武戰報已成功發射至 TG / LINE 陣地中樞！"
            status_text.color = "#10B981"
        else:
            status_text.value = f"📡 本地廣播中樞離線，已在彈窗輸出預覽戰報！"
            status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
            
            preview_dialog = ft.AlertDialog(
                title=ft.Text("🚀 火控發射預覽戰報 (可手動複製發布)"),
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.TextField(value=report, multiline=True, min_lines=12, max_lines=16, read_only=True),
                    width=600
                ),
                actions=[ft.TextButton("關閉", on_click=lambda _: close_dialog(preview_dialog))],
                actions_alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.END,
            )
            open_dialog(preview_dialog)

        page.update()

    # 7. 按鈕控制列 (使用安全圖示獲取)
    icon_bolt = getattr(ft.Icons, "BOLT", "flash_on") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "BOLT", None)
    icon_rocket = getattr(ft.Icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", "rocket") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", None)

    btn_run = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "⚡ 一鍵光速試算 (Execute)",
        icon=icon_bolt,
        bgcolor="#2563EB",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=run_strategy_click,
        height=48
    )

    btn_launch = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "🚀 火控發射至四網 (Broadcast)",
        icon=icon_rocket,
        bgcolor="#DC2626",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=launch_fire_click,
        height=48
    )

    controls_bar = ft.Row([
        template_dropdown,
        btn_run,
        btn_launch,
    ], spacing=15)

    # 8. 畫面總裝
    page.add(
        ft.Column([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Text("👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#F8FAFC"),
                ft.Container(expand=True),
                status_text
            ]),
            controls_bar,
            strategy_desc_card,
            ft.Divider(color="#1F2937", height=1),
            table_container
        ], expand=True, spacing=15)
    )

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 雙模式啟動器 (相容 Flet 1.0 的 ft.run 與舊版 ft.app)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        # Flet 1.0+ 現代標準入口
        ft.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    elif hasattr(ft, "app"):
        # 舊版向下相容入口
        ft.app(target=main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    else:
        import flet
        flet.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)

Clarifying Syntax Discrepancies I've just come across a significant change in Flet syntax. The older versions used `ft.border.all()`, but version 1.0+ requires `ft.Border.all()`. This PascalCase format is key to ensuring that the code runs without an error! It looks like an easy adjustment in the snippets! Updating Border and Alignment I'm now identifying additional syntax updates needed, like `ft.BorderSide(1, "#1E293B")` replacing `ft.border.BorderSide`, and `ft.Alignment.CENTER` for `ft.alignment.center`. python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.0】99 母艦量化範本核武發射艙 (Flet 1.0 完美無瑕版)
檔案名稱：quant_master_launcher.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\quant_master_launcher.py
母艦卡片標題：QuantSqlTemplates 核武量化範本發射
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import logging
import datetime
import warnings
import requests
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import flet as ft

# 壓制 pandas 針對 pyodbc 的連線格式提示警告，維持終端純淨
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning)

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("QuantLauncher")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "server": "localhost",
    "database": "stockchangedate",
    "driver": "{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}",
    "trusted_connection": "yes"
}

CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={DB_CONFIG['database']};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};TrustServerCertificate=yes;"
LOCAL_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flet 1.0 與 0.x 邊框安全相容工廠
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_border_all(width: float, color: str):
    """相容 Flet 1.0+ ft.Border.all 與舊版 ft.border.all"""
    if hasattr(ft, "Border") and hasattr(ft.Border, "all"):
        return ft.Border.all(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "all"):
        return ft.border.all(width, color)
    return None

def get_border_side(width: float, color: str):
    """相容 Flet 1.0+ ft.BorderSide 與舊版 ft.border.BorderSide"""
    if hasattr(ft, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.BorderSide(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.border.BorderSide(width, color)
    return None

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 資料庫操作引擎 (Quant SQL Engine)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class QuantTemplateEngine:
    @staticmethod
    def get_connection():
        return pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_templates(cls):
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, TargetDB, SortOrder, UsageCount, LastUsedDate
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                df = pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
                return df
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"讀取 QuantSqlTemplates 失敗: {e}")
            return pd.DataFrame()

    @classmethod
    def run_template(cls, template_id: int):
        update_sql = """
        UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        SET UsageCount = ISNULL(UsageCount, 0) + 1,
            LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE TemplateID = ?
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(update_sql, (template_id,))
                conn.commit()

                cursor.execute("SELECT CorrectSQL, Title, StrategyDesc FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE TemplateID = ?", (template_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None, "找不到指定的量化範本 ID！", ""

                raw_sql = row[0]
                title = row[1]
                desc = row[2]

                clean_sql = raw_sql
                if "/*" in clean_sql and "*/" in clean_sql:
                    clean_sql = clean_sql.split("*/", 1)[-1].strip()

                if not clean_sql.lower().startswith("select"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql

                df_result = pd.read_sql(clean_sql, conn)
                return df_result, f"✅ 執行成功！共選出 {len(df_result)} 檔標的。", f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"執行範本 {template_id} 失敗: {e}")
            return None, f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}", ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 火控廣播發射核心
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FireControlBroadcaster:
    @staticmethod
    def format_telegram_report(title: str, desc: str, df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> str:
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        msg = f"👑 <b>【99母艦・核武量化戰報】</b>\n"
        msg += f"🎯 <b>策略</b>：{title}\n"
        msg += f"⏰ <b>時間</b>：{now_str}\n"
        msg += f"📝 <b>核心邏輯</b>：{desc[:120]}...\n"
        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        
        if df.empty:
            msg += "⚠️ 本次掃描無符合標的。\n"
            return msg

        sub_df = df.head(top_n)
        for idx, row in sub_df.iterrows():
            code = str(row.get('代號', '')).strip()
            name = str(row.get('名稱', '')).strip()
            price = row.get('現價', row.get('成交價', '-'))
            vol = row.get('成交量(張)', '-')
            pe = row.get('本益比', '-')
            roe = row.get('ROE%', '-')
            tag = row.get('價值成長標籤', row.get('空間判定', ''))

            msg += f"<b>{idx+1}. {code} {name}</b> | 現價: <code>{price}</code>\n"
            detail_line = []
            if pe != '-': detail_line.append(f"PE: {pe}")
            if roe != '-': detail_line.append(f"ROE: {roe}%")
            if vol != '-': detail_line.append(f"量: {vol}張")
            if detail_line:
                msg += f"   └ " + " | ".join(detail_line) + "\n"
            if tag:
                msg += f"   └ 🏷️ <i>{tag}</i>\n"

        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        msg += f"📊 完整選出 {len(df)} 檔，請登入戰情室大屏查閱全譜系。"
        return msg

    @classmethod
    def launch_broadcast(cls, message: str) -> bool:
        try:
            payload = {"message": message, "target": "all"}
            res = requests.post(f"{LOCAL_API_URL}/push_data_to_tg", json=payload, timeout=5)
            return res.status_code == 200
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"通訊中樞發射離線: {e}")
            return False

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 99 母艦 Flet UI 體驗視窗
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙 V16.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.padding = 20
    page.bgcolor = "#0B0E14"

    if hasattr(page, "window") and hasattr(page.window, "width"):
        page.window.width = 1400
        page.window.height = 900
    else:
        page.window_width = 1400
        page.window_height = 900

    current_df = [None]
    current_template_meta = {"title": "", "desc": ""}

    status_text = ft.Text("系統就緒・請選取量化策略範本", color="#64748B", size=13)
    
    # 載入策略清單
    templates_df = QuantTemplateEngine.get_all_templates()
    dropdown_options = []
    if not templates_df.empty:
        for _, row in templates_df.iterrows():
            dropdown_options.append(
                ft.dropdown.Option(
                    key=str(row['TemplateID']),
                    text=f"[{row['Category']}] {row['Title']} (已跑 {row['UsageCount']} 次)"
                )
            )

    template_dropdown = ft.Dropdown(
        label="🎯 選擇量化核武庫策略範本 (QuantSqlTemplates)",
        hint_text="請挑選預載策略...",
        options=dropdown_options,
        width=600,
        bgcolor="#1E293B",
        border_color="#3B82F6",
        color="#F8FAFC"
    )

    desc_content = ft.Text("尚未載入策略...", size=13, color="#94A3B8")
    strategy_desc_card = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([
            ft.Text("📌 策略戰略解說：", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38BDF8"),
            desc_content
        ]),
        bgcolor="#111827",
        padding=15,
        border_radius=8,
        border=get_border_all(1, "#1F2937"),
        width=1340
    )

    table_container = ft.Column(
        scroll=ft.ScrollMode.ADAPTIVE,
        expand=True,
        controls=[ft.Text("請點擊『⚡ 一鍵光速試算』出表...", color="#475569")]
    )

    def on_template_change(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            return
        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        match = templates_df[templates_df['TemplateID'] == tid]
        if not match.empty:
            title = match.iloc[0]['Title']
            desc = match.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
            current_template_meta["title"] = title
            current_template_meta["desc"] = desc
            desc_content.value = f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
            page.update()

    template_dropdown.on_change = on_template_change

    def run_strategy_click(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先選擇一個量化範本！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        status_text.value = f"⏳ 正在調用動態引擎執行範本 ID: {tid}..."
        status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
        page.update()

        df, msg, _ = QuantTemplateEngine.run_template(tid)
        current_df[0] = df
        status_text.value = msg
        status_text.color = "#10B981" if df is not None else "#EF4444"

        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            cols = [ft.DataColumn(ft.Text(col, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#93C5FD")) for col in df.columns]
            rows = []
            for _, r in df.head(50).iterrows():
                cells = []
                for val in r:
                    cells.append(ft.DataCell(ft.Text(str(val) if pd.notnull(val) else "-")))
                rows.append(ft.DataRow(cells=cells))

            table_container.controls = [
                ft.DataTable(
                    columns=cols,
                    rows=rows,
                    border=get_border_all(1, "#334155"),
                    vertical_lines=get_border_side(1, "#1E293B"),
                    heading_row_color="#1E293B",
                    data_row_color={"hovered": "#334155"}
                )
            ]
        else:
            table_container.controls = [ft.Text("無資料符合或查詢異常。", color="#EF4444")]

        page.update()

    def open_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "open"):
            page.open(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "show_dialog"):
            page.show_dialog(dlg)
        else:
            page.dialog = dlg
            dlg.open = True
            page.update()

    def close_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "close"):
            page.close(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "pop_dialog"):
            page.pop_dialog()
        else:
            dlg.open = False
            page.update()

    def launch_fire_click(e):
        if current_df[0] is None or current_df[0].empty:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先執行試算並確認選股清單不為空再行發射！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_telegram_report(
            title=current_template_meta["title"],
            desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
            df=current_df[0],
            top_n=5
        )
        
        success = FireControlBroadcaster.launch_broadcast(report)
        if success:
            status_text.value = f"🚀 核武戰報已成功發射至 TG / LINE 陣地中樞！"
            status_text.color = "#10B981"
        else:
            status_text.value = f"📡 本地廣播中樞離線，已在彈窗輸出預覽戰報！"
            status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
            
            preview_dialog = ft.AlertDialog(
                title=ft.Text("🚀 火控發射預覽戰報 (可手動複製發布)"),
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.TextField(value=report, multiline=True, min_lines=12, max_lines=16, read_only=True),
                    width=600
                ),
                actions=[ft.TextButton("關閉", on_click=lambda _: close_dialog(preview_dialog))],
                actions_alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.END,
            )
            open_dialog(preview_dialog)

        page.update()

    icon_bolt = getattr(ft.Icons, "BOLT", "flash_on") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "BOLT", None)
    icon_rocket = getattr(ft.Icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", "rocket") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", None)

    btn_run = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "⚡ 一鍵光速試算 (Execute)",
        icon=icon_bolt,
        bgcolor="#2563EB",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=run_strategy_click,
        height=48
    )

    btn_launch = ft.ElevatedButton(
        "🚀 火控發射至四網 (Broadcast)",
        icon=icon_rocket,
        bgcolor="#DC2626",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=launch_fire_click,
        height=48
    )

    controls_bar = ft.Row([
        template_dropdown,
        btn_run,
        btn_launch,
    ], spacing=15)

    page.add(
        ft.Column([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Text("👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#F8FAFC"),
                ft.Container(expand=True),
                status_text
            ]),
            controls_bar,
            strategy_desc_card,
            ft.Divider(color="#1F2937", height=1),
            table_container
        ], expand=True, spacing=15)
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        ft.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    elif hasattr(ft, "app"):
        ft.app(target=main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    else:
        import flet
        flet.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)

So, in version 1.0, to get the same functionality, you'd use either `ft.Button(content=...)` or `ft.Button`. This is a straightforward deprecation and replacement. Analyzing Button Migration Logic I've further refined the button migration strategy. The new code prioritizes `ft.Button` in Flet 1.0 but gracefully falls back to `ft.ElevatedButton` for compatibility with 0.x versions. The logic now handles both `content=text` and `text=` arguments for the `ft.Button`, and correctly handles any possible exceptions raised by the newer Flet versions. I'm also considering `ft.TextButton` now. Refining Button Handling Further I'm now zeroing in on handling `ft.TextButton`. Expanding Button Resilience I'm now focusing on ensuring button resilience across Flet versions. I've realized `ft.Button` accepts either `content=ft.Text(...)` or `text=`. To handle different versions effectively, I'm crafting a helper that dynamically selects `ft.Button` or `ft.ElevatedButton` based on availability, with robust handling for `content` and `text` arguments, including potential exceptions. I'm building with forward and backward compatibility in mind. Implementing Button Creation Robustness I'm now implementing the `create_button` and `create_text_button` functions, accounting for both `TypeError` exceptions and the potential absence of `ft.TextButton`. I'm using `getattr` to gracefully handle the possibility of `ft.TextButton` not being available, falling back to a standard `ft.Button` if needed. I'm also addressing the `icon` argument in `ft.Button`, considering the shift from `ft.icons` to `ft.Icons` and ensuring that icon handling is version-agnostic. Verifying DataTable Compatibility I'm now focusing on `DataTable` compatibility. I've confirmed that `DataColumn`, `DataRow`, and `DataCell` remain standard controls. I'm checking the `border`, `vertical_lines`, `heading_row_color`, and `data_row_color` arguments within `DataTable`, particularly ensuring the `data_row_color` (a `MaterialState` dictionary or string) is handled correctly across versions, and I'm constructing a simple test to verify. \n\n Evaluating AlertDialog Behavior Now I'm evaluating the `AlertDialog` control. # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.0】99 母艦量化範本核武發射艙 (Flet 1.0+ 雙軌相容終極版)
檔案名稱：quant_master_launcher.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\quant_master_launcher.py
核心功能：
  1. 動態調度 [stockchangedate].[dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
  2. 完美相容 Flet 1.0 (ft.Button / ft.Border / ft.run / page.open)
  3. 一鍵選股試算、Top 5 戰報格式化與四網發射
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import logging
import datetime
import warnings
import requests
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import flet as ft

# 壓制 pandas 針對 pyodbc 的連線格式提示警告，維持終端純淨
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning)

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("QuantLauncher")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "server": "localhost",
    "database": "stockchangedate",
    "driver": "{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}",
    "trusted_connection": "yes"
}

CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={DB_CONFIG['database']};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};TrustServerCertificate=yes;"
LOCAL_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flet 1.0 與 0.x 跨版本樣式工廠
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_border_all(width: float, color: str):
    """相容 Flet 1.0+ ft.Border.all 與舊版 ft.border.all"""
    if hasattr(ft, "Border") and hasattr(ft.Border, "all"):
        return ft.Border.all(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "all"):
        return ft.border.all(width, color)
    return None

def get_border_side(width: float, color: str):
    """相容 Flet 1.0+ ft.BorderSide 與舊版 ft.border.BorderSide"""
    if hasattr(ft, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.BorderSide(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.border.BorderSide(width, color)
    return None

def create_button(text: str, icon=None, bgcolor=None, color="#FFFFFF", on_click=None, height=48):
    """相容 Flet 1.0 ft.Button 與舊版 ft.ElevatedButton"""
    BtnClass = getattr(ft, "Button", getattr(ft, "ElevatedButton", None))
    try:
        # Flet 1.0+ 標準寫法
        return BtnClass(
            content=ft.Text(text, color=color, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD),
            icon=icon,
            bgcolor=bgcolor,
            on_click=on_click,
            height=height
        )
    except TypeError:
        # 舊版 fallback
        return BtnClass(
            text=text,
            icon=icon,
            bgcolor=bgcolor,
            color=color,
            on_click=on_click,
            height=height
        )

def create_text_button(text: str, on_click=None):
    """相容文字按鈕"""
    TBtnClass = getattr(ft, "TextButton", getattr(ft, "Button", None))
    try:
        return TBtnClass(content=ft.Text(text), on_click=on_click)
    except TypeError:
        return TBtnClass(text=text, on_click=on_click)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 資料庫操作引擎 (Quant SQL Engine)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class QuantTemplateEngine:
    @staticmethod
    def get_connection():
        return pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_templates(cls):
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, TargetDB, SortOrder, UsageCount, LastUsedDate
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                df = pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
                return df
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"讀取 QuantSqlTemplates 失敗: {e}")
            return pd.DataFrame()

    @classmethod
    def run_template(cls, template_id: int):
        update_sql = """
        UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        SET UsageCount = ISNULL(UsageCount, 0) + 1,
            LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE TemplateID = ?
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(update_sql, (template_id,))
                conn.commit()

                cursor.execute("SELECT CorrectSQL, Title, StrategyDesc FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE TemplateID = ?", (template_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None, "找不到指定的量化範本 ID！", ""

                raw_sql = row[0]
                title = row[1]
                desc = row[2]

                clean_sql = raw_sql
                if "/*" in clean_sql and "*/" in clean_sql:
                    clean_sql = clean_sql.split("*/", 1)[-1].strip()

                if not clean_sql.lower().startswith("select"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql

                df_result = pd.read_sql(clean_sql, conn)
                return df_result, f"✅ 執行成功！共選出 {len(df_result)} 檔標的。", f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"執行範本 {template_id} 失敗: {e}")
            return None, f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}", ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 火控廣播發射核心
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FireControlBroadcaster:
    @staticmethod
    def format_telegram_report(title: str, desc: str, df: pd.DataFrame, top_n: int = 5) -> str:
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        msg = f"👑 <b>【99母艦・核武量化戰報】</b>\n"
        msg += f"🎯 <b>策略</b>：{title}\n"
        msg += f"⏰ <b>時間</b>：{now_str}\n"
        msg += f"📝 <b>核心邏輯</b>：{desc[:120]}...\n"
        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        
        if df.empty:
            msg += "⚠️ 本次掃描無符合標的。\n"
            return msg

        sub_df = df.head(top_n)
        for idx, row in sub_df.iterrows():
            code = str(row.get('代號', '')).strip()
            name = str(row.get('名稱', '')).strip()
            price = row.get('現價', row.get('成交價', '-'))
            vol = row.get('成交量(張)', '-')
            pe = row.get('本益比', '-')
            roe = row.get('ROE%', '-')
            tag = row.get('價值成長標籤', row.get('空間判定', ''))

            msg += f"<b>{idx+1}. {code} {name}</b> | 現價: <code>{price}</code>\n"
            detail_line = []
            if pe != '-': detail_line.append(f"PE: {pe}")
            if roe != '-': detail_line.append(f"ROE: {roe}%")
            if vol != '-': detail_line.append(f"量: {vol}張")
            if detail_line:
                msg += f"   └ " + " | ".join(detail_line) + "\n"
            if tag:
                msg += f"   └ 🏷️ <i>{tag}</i>\n"

        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        msg += f"📊 完整選出 {len(df)} 檔，請登入戰情室大屏查閱全譜系。"
        return msg

    @classmethod
    def launch_broadcast(cls, message: str) -> bool:
        try:
            payload = {"message": message, "target": "all"}
            res = requests.post(f"{LOCAL_API_URL}/push_data_to_tg", json=payload, timeout=5)
            return res.status_code == 200
        except Exception as e:
            logger.warning(f"通訊中樞發射離線: {e}")
            return False

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 99 母艦 Flet UI 體驗視窗
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙 V16.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.padding = 20
    page.bgcolor = "#0B0E14"

    # 設定視窗解析度
    if hasattr(page, "window") and hasattr(page.window, "width"):
        page.window.width = 1400
        page.window.height = 900
    else:
        page.window_width = 1400
        page.window_height = 900

    current_df = [None]
    current_template_meta = {"title": "", "desc": ""}

    status_text = ft.Text("系統就緒・請選取量化策略範本", color="#64748B", size=13)
    
    # 載入策略清單
    templates_df = QuantTemplateEngine.get_all_templates()
    dropdown_options = []
    if not templates_df.empty:
        for _, row in templates_df.iterrows():
            dropdown_options.append(
                ft.dropdown.Option(
                    key=str(row['TemplateID']),
                    text=f"[{row['Category']}] {row['Title']} (已跑 {row['UsageCount']} 次)"
                )
            )

    template_dropdown = ft.Dropdown(
        label="🎯 選擇量化核武庫策略範本 (QuantSqlTemplates)",
        hint_text="請挑選預載策略...",
        options=dropdown_options,
        width=600,
        bgcolor="#1E293B",
        border_color="#3B82F6",
        color="#F8FAFC"
    )

    desc_content = ft.Text("尚未載入策略...", size=13, color="#94A3B8")
    strategy_desc_card = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([
            ft.Text("📌 策略戰略解說：", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38BDF8"),
            desc_content
        ]),
        bgcolor="#111827",
        padding=15,
        border_radius=8,
        border=get_border_all(1, "#1F2937"),
        width=1340
    )

    table_container = ft.Column(
        scroll=ft.ScrollMode.ADAPTIVE,
        expand=True,
        controls=[ft.Text("請點擊『⚡ 一鍵光速試算』出表...", color="#475569")]
    )

    def on_template_change(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            return
        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        match = templates_df[templates_df['TemplateID'] == tid]
        if not match.empty:
            title = match.iloc[0]['Title']
            desc = match.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
            current_template_meta["title"] = title
            current_template_meta["desc"] = desc
            desc_content.value = f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
            page.update()

    template_dropdown.on_change = on_template_change

    def run_strategy_click(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先選擇一個量化範本！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        status_text.value = f"⏳ 正在調用動態引擎執行範本 ID: {tid}..."
        status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
        page.update()

        df, msg, _ = QuantTemplateEngine.run_template(tid)
        current_df[0] = df
        status_text.value = msg
        status_text.color = "#10B981" if df is not None else "#EF4444"

        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            cols = [ft.DataColumn(ft.Text(col, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#93C5FD")) for col in df.columns]
            rows = []
            for _, r in df.head(50).iterrows():
                cells = []
                for val in r:
                    cells.append(ft.DataCell(ft.Text(str(val) if pd.notnull(val) else "-")))
                rows.append(ft.DataRow(cells=cells))

            table_container.controls = [
                ft.DataTable(
                    columns=cols,
                    rows=rows,
                    border=get_border_all(1, "#334155"),
                    vertical_lines=get_border_side(1, "#1E293B"),
                    heading_row_color="#1E293B",
                    data_row_color={"hovered": "#334155"}
                )
            ]
        else:
            table_container.controls = [ft.Text("無資料符合或查詢異常。", color="#EF4444")]

        page.update()

    def open_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "open"):
            page.open(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "show_dialog"):
            page.show_dialog(dlg)
        else:
            page.dialog = dlg
            dlg.open = True
            page.update()

    def close_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "close"):
            page.close(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "pop_dialog"):
            page.pop_dialog()
        else:
            dlg.open = False
            page.update()

    def launch_fire_click(e):
        if current_df[0] is None or current_df[0].empty:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先執行試算並確認選股清單不為空再行發射！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_telegram_report(
            title=current_template_meta["title"],
            desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
            df=current_df[0],
            top_n=5
        )
        
        success = FireControlBroadcaster.launch_broadcast(report)
        if success:
            status_text.value = f"🚀 核武戰報已成功發射至 TG / LINE 陣地中樞！"
            status_text.color = "#10B981"
        else:
            status_text.value = f"📡 本地廣播中樞離線，已在彈窗輸出預覽戰報！"
            status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
            
            preview_dialog = ft.AlertDialog(
                title=ft.Text("🚀 火控發射預覽戰報 (可手動複製發布)"),
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.TextField(value=report, multiline=True, min_lines=12, max_lines=16, read_only=True),
                    width=600
                ),
                actions=[create_text_button("關閉", on_click=lambda _: close_dialog(preview_dialog))],
                actions_alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.END,
            )
            open_dialog(preview_dialog)

        page.update()

    # 圖示安全抽取
    icon_bolt = getattr(ft.Icons, "BOLT", "flash_on") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "BOLT", None)
    icon_rocket = getattr(ft.Icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", "rocket") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", None)

    # 採用 Flet 1.0 相容按鈕工廠
    btn_run = create_button(
        text="⚡ 一鍵光速試算 (Execute)",
        icon=icon_bolt,
        bgcolor="#2563EB",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=run_strategy_click,
        height=48
    )

    btn_launch = create_button(
        text="🚀 火控發射至四網 (Broadcast)",
        icon=icon_rocket,
        bgcolor="#DC2626",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=launch_fire_click,
        height=48
    )

    controls_bar = ft.Row([
        template_dropdown,
        btn_run,
        btn_launch,
    ], spacing=15)

    page.add(
        ft.Column([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Text("👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#F8FAFC"),
                ft.Container(expand=True),
                status_text
            ]),
            controls_bar,
            strategy_desc_card,
            ft.Divider(color="#1F2937", height=1),
            table_container
        ], expand=True, spacing=15)
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        ft.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    elif hasattr(ft, "app"):
        ft.app(target=main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    else:
        import flet
        flet.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.0】99 母艦量化範本核武發射艙 (旗艦全功能版)
檔案名稱：quant_master_launcher.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\quant_master_launcher.py
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import json
import logging
import datetime
import warnings
import requests
import pandas as pd
import pyodbc
import flet as ft

# 壓制 pandas 針對 pyodbc 的連線格式提示警告，維持終端純淨
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=UserWarning)

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s [%(levelname)s] %(message)s")
logger = logging.getLogger("QuantLauncher")

DB_CONFIG = {
    "server": "localhost",
    "database": "stockchangedate",
    "driver": "{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}",
    "trusted_connection": "yes"
}

CONN_STR = f"DRIVER={DB_CONFIG['driver']};SERVER={DB_CONFIG['server']};DATABASE={DB_CONFIG['database']};Trusted_Connection={DB_CONFIG['trusted_connection']};TrustServerCertificate=yes;"
LOCAL_API_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:5000"

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Flet 1.0 與 0.x 跨版本樣式工廠
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def get_border_all(width: float, color: str):
    if hasattr(ft, "Border") and hasattr(ft.Border, "all"):
        return ft.Border.all(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "all"):
        return ft.border.all(width, color)
    return None

def get_border_side(width: float, color: str):
    if hasattr(ft, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.BorderSide(width, color)
    elif hasattr(ft, "border") and hasattr(ft.border, "BorderSide"):
        return ft.border.BorderSide(width, color)
    return None

def create_button(text: str, icon=None, bgcolor=None, color="#FFFFFF", on_click=None, height=44):
    BtnClass = getattr(ft, "Button", getattr(ft, "ElevatedButton", None))
    try:
        return BtnClass(
            content=ft.Text(text, color=color, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD),
            icon=icon,
            bgcolor=bgcolor,
            on_click=on_click,
            height=height
        )
    except TypeError:
        return BtnClass(
            text=text,
            icon=icon,
            bgcolor=bgcolor,
            color=color,
            on_click=on_click,
            height=height
        )

def create_text_button(text: str, icon=None, on_click=None):
    TBtnClass = getattr(ft, "TextButton", getattr(ft, "Button", None))
    try:
        return TBtnClass(content=ft.Text(text), icon=icon, on_click=on_click)
    except TypeError:
        return TBtnClass(text=text, icon=icon, on_click=on_click)

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 資料庫操作引擎 (Quant SQL Engine)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class QuantTemplateEngine:
    @staticmethod
    def get_connection():
        return pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10)

    @classmethod
    def get_all_templates(cls):
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL, TargetDB, SortOrder, UsageCount, LastUsedDate
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE IsActive = 1
        ORDER BY SortOrder ASC, TemplateID ASC
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                df = pd.read_sql(sql, conn)
                return df
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"讀取 QuantSqlTemplates 失敗: {e}")
            return pd.DataFrame()

    @classmethod
    def run_template(cls, template_id: int):
        update_sql = """
        UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        SET UsageCount = ISNULL(UsageCount, 0) + 1,
            LastUsedDate = GETDATE()
        WHERE TemplateID = ?
        """
        try:
            with cls.get_connection() as conn:
                cursor = conn.cursor()
                cursor.execute(update_sql, (template_id,))
                conn.commit()

                cursor.execute("SELECT CorrectSQL, Title, StrategyDesc FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] WHERE TemplateID = ?", (template_id,))
                row = cursor.fetchone()
                if not row:
                    return None, "找不到指定的量化範本 ID！", ""

                raw_sql = row[0]
                title = row[1]
                desc = row[2]

                clean_sql = raw_sql
                if "/*" in clean_sql and "*/" in clean_sql:
                    clean_sql = clean_sql.split("*/", 1)[-1].strip()

                if not clean_sql.lower().startswith("select"):
                    clean_sql = "SELECT " + clean_sql

                df_result = pd.read_sql(clean_sql, conn)
                return df_result, f"✅ 執行成功！共選出 {len(df_result)} 檔標的。", f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
        except Exception as e:
            logger.error(f"執行範本 {template_id} 失敗: {e}")
            return None, f"❌ SQL 執行失敗: {str(e)}", ""

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 火控廣播發射核心 (支援 TG HTML 與 LINE/FB Markdown 雙模)
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
class FireControlBroadcaster:
    @staticmethod
    def format_report(title: str, desc: str, df: pd.DataFrame, mode: str = "plain", top_n: int = 5) -> str:
        """
        mode: 'html' (Telegram) 或 'plain' (LINE / Discord / FB Markdown)
        """
        now_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
        
        if mode == "html":
            msg = f"👑 <b>【99母艦・核武量化戰報】</b>\n"
            msg += f"🎯 <b>策略</b>：{title}\n"
            msg += f"⏰ <b>時間</b>：{now_str}\n"
            msg += f"📝 <b>核心邏輯</b>：{desc[:100]}...\n"
            msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        else:
            msg = f"👑【99母艦・核武量化戰報】\n"
            msg += f"🎯 策略：{title}\n"
            msg += f"⏰ 時間：{now_str}\n"
            msg += f"📝 核心邏輯：{desc[:100]}...\n"
            msg += f"────────────────────\n"

        if df.empty:
            msg += "⚠️ 本次掃描無符合標的。\n"
            return msg

        sub_df = df.head(top_n)
        for idx, row in sub_df.iterrows():
            code = str(row.get('代號', '')).strip()
            name = str(row.get('名稱', '')).strip()
            price = row.get('現價', row.get('成交價', '-'))
            vol = row.get('成交量(張)', '-')
            pe = row.get('本益比', '-')
            roe = row.get('ROE%', '-')
            tag = row.get('價值成長標籤', row.get('空間判定', row.get('熱門題材', '')))

            if mode == "html":
                msg += f"<b>{idx+1}. {code} {name}</b> | 現價: <code>{price}</code>\n"
            else:
                msg += f"{idx+1}. {code} {name} | 現價: {price}\n"

            detail_line = []
            if pe != '-': detail_line.append(f"PE: {pe}")
            if roe != '-': detail_line.append(f"ROE: {roe}%")
            if vol != '-': detail_line.append(f"量: {vol}張")
            if detail_line:
                msg += f"   └ " + " | ".join(detail_line) + "\n"
            if tag:
                if mode == "html":
                    msg += f"   └ 🏷️ <i>{tag}</i>\n"
                else:
                    msg += f"   └ 🏷️ [{tag}]\n"

        msg += f"────────────────────\n"
        msg += f"📊 完整選出 {len(df)} 檔，請登入戰情室大屏查閱全譜系。"
        return msg

    @classmethod
    def launch_broadcast(cls, message: str) -> bool:
        try:
            payload = {"message": message, "target": "all"}
            res = requests.post(f"{LOCAL_API_URL}/push_data_to_tg", json=payload, timeout=3)
            return res.status_code == 200
        except Exception:
            return False

# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 99 母艦 Flet UI 體驗視窗
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main(page: ft.Page):
    page.title = "👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙 V16.0"
    page.theme_mode = ft.ThemeMode.DARK
    page.padding = 20
    page.bgcolor = "#0B0E14"

    if hasattr(page, "window") and hasattr(page.window, "width"):
        page.window.width = 1400
        page.window.height = 900
    else:
        page.window_width = 1400
        page.window_height = 900

    current_df = [None]
    current_template_meta = {"title": "", "desc": ""}

    status_text = ft.Text("系統就緒・請選取量化策略範本", color="#64748B", size=13)
    
    # 載入所有範本
    templates_df = QuantTemplateEngine.get_all_templates()
    dropdown_options = []
    default_tid = None

    if not templates_df.empty:
        default_tid = str(templates_df.iloc[0]['TemplateID'])
        current_template_meta["title"] = templates_df.iloc[0]['Title']
        current_template_meta["desc"] = templates_df.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
        for _, row in templates_df.iterrows():
            dropdown_options.append(
                ft.dropdown.Option(
                    key=str(row['TemplateID']),
                    text=f"[{row['Category']}] {row['Title']} (已跑 {row['UsageCount']} 次)"
                )
            )

    template_dropdown = ft.Dropdown(
        label="🎯 選擇量化核武庫策略範本 (QuantSqlTemplates)",
        hint_text="請挑選預載策略...",
        options=dropdown_options,
        value=default_tid,
        width=600,
        bgcolor="#1E293B",
        color="#F8FAFC"
    )

    desc_content = ft.Text(
        f"【{current_template_meta['title']}】\n{current_template_meta['desc']}" if default_tid else "尚未載入策略...",
        size=13,
        color="#94A3B8"
    )

    strategy_desc_card = ft.Container(
        content=ft.Column([
            ft.Text("📌 策略戰略解說：", weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#38BDF8"),
            desc_content
        ]),
        bgcolor="#111827",
        padding=15,
        border_radius=8,
        border=get_border_all(1, "#1F2937"),
        width=1340
    )

    table_container = ft.Column(
        scroll=ft.ScrollMode.ADAPTIVE,
        expand=True,
        controls=[ft.Text("請點擊『⚡ 一鍵光速試算』出表...", color="#475569")]
    )

    def on_template_change(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            return
        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        match = templates_df[templates_df['TemplateID'] == tid]
        if not match.empty:
            title = match.iloc[0]['Title']
            desc = match.iloc[0]['StrategyDesc']
            current_template_meta["title"] = title
            current_template_meta["desc"] = desc
            desc_content.value = f"【{title}】\n{desc}"
            page.update()

    template_dropdown.on_change = on_template_change

    def run_strategy_click(e):
        if not template_dropdown.value:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先選擇一個量化範本！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        tid = int(template_dropdown.value)
        status_text.value = f"⏳ 正在調用動態引擎執行範本 ID: {tid}..."
        status_text.color = "#38BDF8"
        page.update()

        df, msg, _ = QuantTemplateEngine.run_template(tid)
        current_df[0] = df
        status_text.value = msg
        status_text.color = "#10B981" if df is not None else "#EF4444"

        if df is not None and not df.empty:
            cols = [ft.DataColumn(ft.Text(col, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#93C5FD")) for col in df.columns]
            rows = []
            for _, r in df.head(50).iterrows():
                cells = []
                for val in r:
                    cells.append(ft.DataCell(ft.Text(str(val) if pd.notnull(val) else "-")))
                rows.append(ft.DataRow(cells=cells))

            table_container.controls = [
                ft.DataTable(
                    columns=cols,
                    rows=rows,
                    border=get_border_all(1, "#334155"),
                    vertical_lines=get_border_side(1, "#1E293B"),
                    heading_row_color="#1E293B",
                    data_row_color={"hovered": "#334155"}
                )
            ]
        else:
            table_container.controls = [ft.Text("無資料符合或查詢異常。", color="#EF4444")]

        page.update()

    def open_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "open"):
            page.open(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "show_dialog"):
            page.show_dialog(dlg)
        else:
            page.dialog = dlg
            dlg.open = True
            page.update()

    def close_dialog(dlg):
        if hasattr(page, "close"):
            page.close(dlg)
        elif hasattr(page, "pop_dialog"):
            page.pop_dialog()
        else:
            dlg.open = False
            page.update()

    def launch_fire_click(e):
        if current_df[0] is None or current_df[0].empty:
            status_text.value = "⚠️ 請先執行試算並確認選股清單不為空再行發射！"
            status_text.color = "#F59E0B"
            page.update()
            return

        # 優先嘗試向 Port 5000 廣播
        tg_report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_report(
            title=current_template_meta["title"],
            desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
            df=current_df[0],
            mode="html",
            top_n=5
        )
        
        success = FireControlBroadcaster.launch_broadcast(tg_report)
        if success:
            status_text.value = f"🚀 核武戰報已成功直發至 TG / LINE 陣地中樞！"
            status_text.color = "#10B981"
            page.update()
        else:
            status_text.value = f"📡 本地廣播中樞離線，已開啟高格式雙模戰報彈窗！"
            status_text.color = "#38BDF8"

            # 預設 Markdown 格式（社群通用）
            plain_report = FireControlBroadcaster.format_report(
                title=current_template_meta["title"],
                desc=current_template_meta["desc"],
                df=current_df[0],
                mode="plain",
                top_n=5
            )

            report_box = ft.TextField(
                value=plain_report,
                multiline=True,
                min_lines=12,
                max_lines=15,
                read_only=True,
                border_color="#334155"
            )

            format_status = ft.Text("目前模式：LINE / Discord / FB 通用排版", size=12, color="#38BDF8")

            def switch_format(mode_name):
                if mode_name == "plain":
                    report_box.value = plain_report
                    format_status.value = "目前模式：LINE / Discord / FB 通用排版"
                else:
                    report_box.value = tg_report
                    format_status.value = "目前模式：Telegram 專用 HTML 排版"
                page.update()

            def copy_to_clipboard(e_c):
                page.set_clipboard(report_box.value)
                status_text.value = "📋 戰報內容已成功複製至剪貼簿！"
                status_text.color = "#10B981"
                page.update()

            preview_dialog = ft.AlertDialog(
                title=ft.Text("🚀 火控發射預覽戰報 (可手動複製或發布)"),
                content=ft.Container(
                    content=ft.Column([
                        ft.Row([
                            ft.TextButton("切換 LINE/FB 通用版", on_click=lambda _: switch_format("plain")),
                            ft.TextButton("切換 TG HTML 版", on_click=lambda _: switch_format("html")),
                            ft.Container(expand=True),
                            format_status
                        ]),
                        report_box
                    ], spacing=10),
                    width=620
                ),
                actions=[
                    create_button("📋 複製到剪貼簿", icon=getattr(ft.Icons, "COPY", "copy"), on_click=copy_to_clipboard, height=36),
                    create_text_button("關閉", on_click=lambda _: close_dialog(preview_dialog))
                ],
                actions_alignment=ft.MainAxisAlignment.END,
            )
            open_dialog(preview_dialog)

        page.update()

    icon_bolt = getattr(ft.Icons, "BOLT", "flash_on") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "BOLT", None)
    icon_rocket = getattr(ft.Icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", "rocket") if hasattr(ft, "Icons") else getattr(ft.icons, "ROCKET_LAUNCH", None)

    btn_run = create_button(
        text="⚡ 一鍵光速試算 (Execute)",
        icon=icon_bolt,
        bgcolor="#2563EB",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=run_strategy_click,
        height=44
    )

    btn_launch = create_button(
        text="🚀 火控發射至四網 (Broadcast)",
        icon=icon_rocket,
        bgcolor="#DC2626",
        color="#FFFFFF",
        on_click=launch_fire_click,
        height=44
    )

    controls_bar = ft.Row([
        template_dropdown,
        btn_run,
        btn_launch,
    ], spacing=15)

    page.add(
        ft.Column([
            ft.Row([
                ft.Text("👑 99 母艦・量化範本核武發射艙", size=22, weight=ft.FontWeight.BOLD, color="#F8FAFC"),
                ft.Container(expand=True),
                status_text
            ]),
            controls_bar,
            strategy_desc_card,
            ft.Divider(color="#1F2937", height=1),
            table_container
        ], expand=True, spacing=15)
    )

if __name__ == "__main__":
    if hasattr(ft, "run"):
        ft.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    elif hasattr(ft, "app"):
        ft.app(target=main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)
    else:
        import flet
        flet.run(main, port=8552, view=ft.AppView.WEB_BROWSER)

import os

import html
import json
