load_global_stock_dict()

def parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text):
    text_clean = raw_text.replace(" ", "").upper()
    target_code, target_name = None, None

    for name in sorted(GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
        if name.upper() in text_clean:
            target_code = GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT[name]
            target_name = name
            break
    
    if not target_code:
        match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', text_clean)
        if match: target_code, target_name = match.group(1), match.group(1)

    if target_code:
        if any(k in text_clean for k in ["離場", "勝率", "出場", "賣點"]): return f"{target_code}?3", f"查詢【{target_name}】離場勝率"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["籌碼", "大戶", "集中度"]): return f"{target_code}?4", f"查詢【{target_name}】籌碼大戶動向"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["價值", "成本", "便宜"]): return f"{target_code}?2", f"查詢【{target_name}】主力成本價值區"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["分時", "轉強", "金叉", "動能"]): return f"{target_code}?1", f"查詢【{target_name}】分時轉強動能"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["圖", "截圖", "走勢"]): return f"{target_code}??", f"產出【{target_name}】四圖大滿貫"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["代號", "股號"]): return f"{target_code}?", f"鎖定【{target_name}】({target_code})"
        else: return f"{target_code}?", f"啟動【{target_name}】全知戰報"
    
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["發射", "策略", "黑馬"]): return "FIRE_STRATEGY_1", "啟動量化核武發射艙"
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["指令", "功能", "幫助", "說明", "選單"]): return "HELP", "呼叫指揮官說明書"

    return None, None

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️ 3. 資料查詢與 AI 生成核心
# =========================================================================
def extract_pure_code(text):
    m = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})', str(text))
    return m.group(1) if m else ""

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f: requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, timeout=3)
    except Exception: pass

def fetch_complete_stock_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    result = {}
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'")
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: result.update(dict(zip([c[0] for c in cursor.description], row)))
            
            sql_detail = """SELECT TOP 1 A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit, ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號) LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號) WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;"""
            cursor.execute(sql_detail, (clean_code, clean_code))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r: result.update({"optimal": str(r[3]), "c1": float(r[4] or 0), "osc_60m": float(r[5] or 0), "weather": str(r[6])})
    except Exception: pass
    return result if ("代號" in result or "名稱" in result) else None

def build_tactical_prompt(data, sub_mode=0):
    return f"""你是一位頂級量化總監。請根據以下唯一真實數據庫，為【{data.get('名稱','')}({data.get('代號','')}】進行深度戰術解盤。嚴格禁止猜測未提供資訊。
【量化數據庫】：{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)}
請精準輸出戰術判定，並以「👑 總監一句話戰令：」結尾。"""

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    candidates = [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] != _working_gemini_model] if _working_gemini_model else GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            try:
                r = requests.post(f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}", json={"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}]}, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=15)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    content = r.json().get("candidates", [])[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                    if content: _working_gemini_model = model_id; return content, model_name
            except Exception: continue
    return None, None

def generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0):
    prompt_text = build_tactical_prompt(stock_data, sub_mode)
    content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        try:
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"}, json={"model": model_id, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}]}, timeout=15)
            if r.status_code == 200: return r.json()["choices"][0]["message"].get("content", "").strip(), model_name
        except Exception: pass
    return "❌ 系統大腦維護中，請稍候再試。", "系統維護中"

# =========================================================================
# 💬 4. Telegram 監聽核心 (多線程不卡死)
# =========================================================================
def send_welcome(chat_id):
    welcome_text = (
        "🤖 【Zen AI 股票戰情室 雙向操盤旗艦 V5.1】\n\n"
        "👑 【口語自然語言】：\n"
        "• 輸入：「查台積電的勝率」 ➔ 系統秒回戰報！\n"
        "• 指令：「發射量化策略」 ➔ 啟動核武發射艙！\n\n"
        "👑 【純英數極速火控】：\n"
        "• `2317?`  ➔ 👑 旗艦全知戰報\n"
        "• `2317?1` ➔ ⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強\n"
        "• `2317?2` ➔ 🧱 3D AMT 價值區\n"
        "• `2317?3` ➔ 🛡️ 3-Way 離場勝率\n"
        "• `2317?4` ➔ 💎 籌碼集中度\n"
        "• `2317??` ➔ 📸 圖文大滿貫\n"
        "• `2317B`  ➔ 📡 四網大一統齊發\n"
        "• `?` ➔ 🌟 60M 金叉黑馬榜"
    )
    bot.send_message(chat_id, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda msg: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    threading.Thread(target=process_message_worker, args=(message,), daemon=True).start()

def process_message_worker(message):
    try:
        # 防閃退裝甲：避免收到圖片貼圖等非文字訊息時崩潰
        if not message.text: return
        
        chat_id = message.chat.id
        raw_text = message.text.strip().replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!')
        
        # 🌟 NLP 智能攔截判斷
        if "?" not in raw_text and not re.search(r'\d{4,6}[bB!]', raw_text):
            parsed_cmd, reply_intent = parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text)
            if parsed_cmd:
                if parsed_cmd == "HELP":
                    send_welcome(chat_id)
                    return
                bot.send_message(chat_id, f"🗣️ [自然語言解析] 鎖定意圖: {reply_intent}\n👉 觸發指令: `{parsed_cmd}`", parse_mode="Markdown")
                raw_text = parsed_cmd
            else:
                if len(raw_text) > 2 and not raw_text.isdigit():
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 未能解析您的指令：「{raw_text}」，請確認是否包含有效股號或名稱。")
                return

        print(f"\n📩 [進入火控管線] 指令: 「{raw_text}」")

        # 🚀 發射艙指令
        if raw_text == "FIRE_STRATEGY_1":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "🚀 [指令確認] 正在背景啟動【量化範本核武發射艙】...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "quant_master_launcher.py")], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text("✅ 【發射艙】已啟動！稍後將直接把 Top 5 戰報送達本群！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 🎯 ? 黑馬榜指令
        if raw_text == "?":
            bot.send_message(chat_id, "⚡ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
            return

        clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)
        if not clean_code: return

        # 🚀 B/! 廣播指令
        if re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*([bB!])', raw_text):
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在向 TG/LINE/FB 同步發射【{clean_code}】戰報...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "zen_broadcaster.py"), "--code", clean_code], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text(f"🚀 【{clean_code}】四網廣播已發射！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 🎯 ?1~?4 全知戰報指令
        omni_match = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*(\?{1,2})\s*([0-9])?', raw_text)
        if omni_match:
            sub_mode = int(omni_match.group(3)) if (omni_match and omni_match.group(3)) else 0
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在調用 AI 大腦為【{clean_code}】生成深度戰報...")

            stock_data = fetch_complete_stock_data(clean_code)
            if not stock_data:
                bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 查無【{clean_code}】資料庫記錄！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return

            analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode)
            full_report = f"🎯 【{stock_data.get('名稱','')} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI 戰報\n└ 大腦: {used_brain}\n\n{analysis}"
            
            try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            except Exception: pass

            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)
            return

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 處理訊息時發生嚴重錯誤: {e}")

# =========================================================================
# 🚀 5. 啟動入口
# =========================================================================
def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向操盤機器人 Flagship V5.1 (霸王清場版)】啟動！")
    print("=" * 70)
    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=25, long_polling_timeout=20)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def auto_detect_tokens():

    detected_or_key = ""
    candidates = ["zen_ai_bot2.py", "update_notioninfo_OpenRouter.py", "chart_explain.py", "zen_broadcaster.py", "ai_omni_explainer.py"]

                        if or_m and not or_m.group(1).startswith("sk-or-v1-c29"):
                            detected_or_key = or_m.group(1)
            except Exception: pass
            
    final_g_keys = list(dict.fromkeys(detected_g_keys))
    return final_g_keys, detected_or_key

load_global_stock_dict()

def parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text):
    text_clean = raw_text.replace(" ", "").upper()
    target_code, target_name = None, None

    for name in sorted(GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
        if name.upper() in text_clean:
            target_code = GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT[name]
            target_name = name
            break
    
    if not target_code:
        match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', text_clean)
        if match: target_code, target_name = match.group(1), match.group(1)

    if target_code:
        if any(k in text_clean for k in ["離場", "勝率", "出場", "賣點"]): return f"{target_code}?3", f"查詢【{target_name}】離場勝率"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["籌碼", "大戶", "集中度"]): return f"{target_code}?4", f"查詢【{target_name}】籌碼大戶動向"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["價值", "成本", "便宜"]): return f"{target_code}?2", f"查詢【{target_name}】主力成本價值區"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["分時", "轉強", "金叉", "動能"]): return f"{target_code}?1", f"查詢【{target_name}】分時轉強動能"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["圖", "截圖", "走勢"]): return f"{target_code}??", f"產出【{target_name}】四圖大滿貫"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["代號", "股號"]): return f"{target_code}?", f"鎖定【{target_name}】({target_code})"
        else: return f"{target_code}?", f"啟動【{target_name}】全知戰報"
    
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["發射", "策略", "黑馬"]): return "FIRE_STRATEGY_1", "啟動量化核武發射艙"
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["指令", "功能", "幫助", "說明", "選單"]): return "HELP", "呼叫指揮官說明書"

    return None, None

def extract_pure_code(text):
    m = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})', str(text))
    return m.group(1) if m else ""

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f: requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, timeout=3)
    except Exception: pass

def fetch_complete_stock_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    result = {}
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'")
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: result.update(dict(zip([c[0] for c in cursor.description], row)))
            
            sql_detail = """SELECT TOP 1 A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit, ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號) LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號) WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;"""
            cursor.execute(sql_detail, (clean_code, clean_code))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r: result.update({"optimal": str(r[3]), "c1": float(r[4] or 0), "osc_60m": float(r[5] or 0), "weather": str(r[6])})
    except Exception as e: print(f"⚠️ 查詢異常: {e}")
    return result if ("代號" in result or "名稱" in result) else None

def build_tactical_prompt(data, sub_mode=0):
    mode_desc = {
        0: "輸出旗艦全知戰報（含 Markdown 實戰戰術指令單表格）",
        1: "針對 60M 分時動能與當日攻防點位輸出伏兵轉強戰報",
        2: "針對 3D AMT 三維主力成本與突圍空間輸出價值區戰報",
        3: "針對 3-Way 5/10/20MA 歷史離場勝率PK與凱利風控輸出勝率戰報",
        4: "針對主力與籌碼集中度多空定性輸出籌碼戰報"
    }.get(sub_mode, "輸出全知戰報")

    return f"""你是一位頂級量化總監。請根據以下唯一真實數據庫，為【{data.get('名稱','')}({data.get('代號','')}】{mode_desc}。
嚴格禁止猜測未提供資訊，請直接針砭實戰應對策略，最後務必以「👑 總監一句話戰令：」結尾。
【量化數據庫】：
{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}"""

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    candidates = [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] + [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] != _working_gemini_model] if _working_gemini_model else GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES
    
    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            try:
                url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent?key={key}"
                r = requests.post(url, json={"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}]}, headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"}, timeout=15)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    content = r.json().get("candidates", [])[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                    if content:
                        _working_gemini_model = model_id
                        return content, model_name
                else:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} HTTP {r.status_code}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 異常: {e}")
    return None, None

def generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0):
    prompt_text = build_tactical_prompt(stock_data, sub_mode)
    
    # 1. 優先呼叫 Google 原廠
    content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 2. 備援呼叫 OpenRouter
    if OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
        for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
            try:
                r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"}, json={"model": model_id, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}]}, timeout=15)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    ans = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"].get("content", "").strip()
                    if ans: return ans, model_name
            except Exception: pass

    # 3. 本地 Ollama 實體保底
    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": OLLAMA_MODEL, "prompt": prompt_text, "stream": False}, timeout=15)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            ans = r.json().get("response", "").strip()
            if ans: return ans, f"🛡️ 本地 Ollama ({OLLAMA_MODEL})"
    except Exception: pass

    return "❌ 系統大腦正在調度金鑰，請稍候 10 秒重試！", "金鑰切換中"

def send_welcome(chat_id):
    welcome_text = (
        "🤖 【Zen AI 股票戰情室 雙向操盤旗艦 V5.2】\n\n"
        "👑 【口語自然語言】：\n"
        "• 輸入：「查台積電的勝率」 ➔ 系統秒回戰報！\n"
        "• 指令：「發射量化策略」 ➔ 啟動核武發射艙！\n\n"
        "👑 【極速代碼火控】：\n"
        "• `2317?`  ➔ 👑 旗艦全知戰報\n"
        "• `2317?1` ➔ ⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強\n"
        "• `2317?2` ➔ 🧱 3D AMT 價值區\n"
        "• `2317?3` ➔ 🛡️ 3-Way 離場勝率\n"
        "• `2317?4` ➔ 💎 籌碼集中度\n"
        "• `2317??` ➔ 📸 圖文大滿貫\n"
        "• `2317B`  ➔ 📡 四網大一統齊發\n"
        "• `?` ➔ 🌟 60M 金叉黑馬榜"
    )
    bot.send_message(chat_id, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda msg: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    threading.Thread(target=process_message_worker, args=(message,), daemon=True).start()

def process_message_worker(message):
    try:
        if not message.text: return
        chat_id = message.chat.id
        raw_text = message.text.strip().replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!')
        
        # 🌟 NLP 智能攔截
        if "?" not in raw_text and not re.search(r'\d{4,6}[bB!]', raw_text):
            parsed_cmd, reply_intent = parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text)
            if parsed_cmd:
                if parsed_cmd == "HELP":
                    send_welcome(chat_id)
                    return
                bot.send_message(chat_id, f"🗣️ [自然語言解析] 鎖定意圖: {reply_intent}\n👉 觸發指令: `{parsed_cmd}`", parse_mode="Markdown")
                raw_text = parsed_cmd
            else:
                if len(raw_text) > 2 and not raw_text.isdigit():
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 未能解析您的指令：「{raw_text}」，請確認是否包含有效股號或名稱。")
                return

        print(f"\n📩 [進入火控管線] 指令: 「{raw_text}」")

        if raw_text == "FIRE_STRATEGY_1":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "🚀 [指令確認] 正在背景啟動【量化範本核武發射艙】...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "quant_master_launcher.py")], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text("✅ 【發射艙】已啟動！稍後將直接把 Top 5 戰報送達本群！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        if raw_text == "?":
            bot.send_message(chat_id, "⚡ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
            return

        clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)
        if not clean_code: return

        if re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*([bB!])', raw_text):
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在向 TG/LINE/FB 同步發射【{clean_code}】戰報...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "zen_broadcaster.py"), "--code", clean_code], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text(f"🚀 【{clean_code}】四網大一統廣播已發射！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        omni_match = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*(\?{1,2})\s*([0-9])?', raw_text)
        if omni_match:
            sub_mode = int(omni_match.group(3)) if (omni_match and omni_match.group(3)) else 0
            sub_mode_name = {0:"全知戰報", 1:"60M伏兵動能", 2:"3D AMT價值區", 3:"3-Way離場勝率", 4:"籌碼大戶集中度"}.get(sub_mode, "全知戰報")
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在調用 AI 大腦為【{clean_code}】生成【{sub_mode_name}】深度戰報...")

            stock_data = fetch_complete_stock_data(clean_code)
            if not stock_data:
                bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 查無【{clean_code}】資料庫記錄！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return

            analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode)
            clean_name = stock_data.get('名稱', '')
            full_report = f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI {sub_mode_name}\n└ 大腦: {used_brain}\n\n{analysis}"
            
            try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            except Exception: pass

            bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)
            send_to_line(full_report)
            return

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 處理訊息異常: {e}")

def main():
    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向操盤機器人 Flagship V5.2】啟動！")
    print(f"🔑 成功自動掛載 Gemini 金鑰: {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 | OpenRouter: {'已連線' if OPENROUTER_API_KEY else '未設定'}")
    print("=" * 70)
    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=25, long_polling_timeout=20)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import os

SCRIPT_DIR = r"C:\test_c"

try:
    from zen_secrets import GEMINI_API_KEYS, OPENROUTER_API_KEY

print("【🌐 1. OpenRouter 備援金鑰測試】")
if OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
    masked_or = OPENROUTER_API_KEY[:12] + "..." + OPENROUTER_API_KEY[-6:]
    try:
        r = requests.get(
            "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/auth/key",
            headers={"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}"},

        )
        if r.status_code == 200:
            usage = round(r.json().get("data", {}).get("usage", 0.0), 6)

        else:

    except Exception as e:

print("\n" + "-" * 65 + "\n")

print(f"【👑 2. Google 原廠 Gemini 金鑰測試】(共 {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 把)")

for idx, key in enumerate(GEMINI_API_KEYS, 1):
    masked_key = key[:11] + "..." + key[-6:]
    tag = "[🌟 AQ. 認證神鑰]" if key.startswith("AQ.") else "[AIza 密鑰]"
    
    # 官方標準：採用 x-goog-api-key 標頭
    headers = {
        "x-goog-api-key": key,
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    
    start_t = time.time()
    try:
        # 第一步：動態詢問 Google 這把 Key 可用的所有模型
        r_models = requests.get("https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models", headers=headers, timeout=12)
        elapsed = round(time.time() - start_t, 2)
        
        if r_models.status_code == 200:
            models_data = r_models.json().get("models", [])
            # 篩選出支援 generateContent 的模型
            valid_models = [
                m["name"].replace("models/", "")
                for m in models_data
                if "generateContent" in m.get("supportedGenerationMethods", [])
            ]
            
            # 自動挑選最適合的 Flash 模型 (優先找 flash)
            target_model = next((m for m in valid_models if "flash" in m.lower()), valid_models[0] if valid_models else "gemini-1.5-flash")
            
            # 第二步：使用 Google 推薦的正式模型進行實測推論
            url_gen = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{target_model}:generateContent"
            payload = {"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": "請回覆OK"}]}]}
            
            r_gen = requests.post(url_gen, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=25)
            
            if r_gen.status_code == 200:
                print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ✅ 100% 滿血有效！(適配模型: {target_model} | 延遲: {elapsed}s | 200 OK)")
            elif r_gen.status_code == 429:
                print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ⚠️ 認證有效但 429 頻率冷卻中 (適配模型: {target_model})")
            else:
                err_msg = r_gen.json().get("error", {}).get("message", str(r_gen.status_code))
                print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ⚠️ 認證通過但推論返回 HTTP {r_gen.status_code} ({err_msg})")
                
        elif r_models.status_code == 400:
            print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ❌ 無效金鑰 (HTTP 400)")
        elif r_models.status_code == 403:
            print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ❌ 權限被拒 (HTTP 403)")
        else:
            print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ❌ 認證失敗: HTTP {r_models.status_code}")
            
    except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
        print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ⏳ 連線超時 (跨洋網路抖動)")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  🔑 [{idx}] {masked_key} {tag} ➔ ⚠️ 連線異常: {e}")

print("\n" + "=" * 65)

GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES = [
    ("gemini-3.8-flash",      "⚡ Google 原廠 3.8 Flash (官方最新旗艦/41分)"),

    ("gemini-3.5-flash-lite", "⚡ Google 原廠 3.5 Flash Lite")
]

def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    candidates = (
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] +
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]
    ) if _working_gemini_model else GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:

                    "x-goog-api-key": key,
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                }
                url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
                payload = {"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}]}
                
                r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=20)
                
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    data = r.json()
                    candidates_list = data.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_list:
                        content = candidates_list[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if content:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id

                            return content, model_name
                else:

                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} HTTP {r.status_code}: {err_msg}")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 連線異常: {e}")
                
    return None, None

GEMINI_CHIEF_CANDIDATES = [

    ("gemini-3.6-flash", "🚀 Google 原廠 3.6 Flash (極速次世代)")
]

def call_gemini_chief(prompt_text):
    """專門為總參謀長長篇深度戰報打造之推論引擎 (放寬超時至 45 秒)"""
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return None, None

    for model_id, model_name in GEMINI_CHIEF_CANDIDATES:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            try:
                headers = {
                    "x-goog-api-key": key,
                    "Content-Type": "application/json"
                }
                url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
                payload = {
                    "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}],
                    "generationConfig": {
                        "temperature": 0.25,
                        "maxOutputTokens": 8192  # 確保完整產出 2000 字不腰斬
                    }
                }
                
                # 🌟 核心關鍵：放寬至 45 秒！給予深度長文充足的跨洋生成時間！
                r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=45)
                
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    data = r.json()
                    candidates = data.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates:
                        content = candidates[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        if len(content) > 200:
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 503:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 伺服器擁塞 (503)，0.1 秒秒切下一階梯隊！")
                    break  # 遇 503 不浪費時間換 key，直接換下個模型
                else:
                    err_msg = r.json().get('error', {}).get('message', '')[:60]
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} HTTP {r.status_code}: {err_msg}")
            except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
                print(f"⏳ {model_name} 推論超過 45 秒，轉入下一組備援！")
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 連線異常: {e}")
                
    return None, None

# 1. 量化情報層：myword_2.html 權威「專家分 ✕ 法人共振 ✕ 主力成本」
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def fetch_quant_candidates():
    print("[1/4] 啟動量化雷達，萃取 Master 核心候選標的...")
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10
        RTRIM(M.代號) AS 代號, 
        RTRIM(M.名稱) AS 名稱,
        ISNULL(B.成交價, 0) AS 現價, 
        ISNULL(B.漲幅, 0) AS 今日漲幅, 
        ISNULL(B.總量, 0) AS 成交量,
        RTRIM(M.產業分類) AS 產業, 
        ISNULL(B.股本億, 0) AS 股本億,
        ROUND(M.專家實戰總分, 2) AS 專家分,
        ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0) AS 外資3日,
        ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) AS 投信3日,
        ISNULL(V.本益比近四季, 0) AS 本益比,
        ISNULL(O.短線20日主力成本, 0) AS 主力成本,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(O.乖離戰術判定), N'貼近成本') AS 乖離判定,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(O.三維AMT空間判定), N'常態空間') AS 空間判定,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(M.具體概念), N'權值動能') AS 熱門題材
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis M
    JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 外資3日合計, 投信3日合計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTRIM(代號) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM threemasternumber
    ) N ON RTRIM(N.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND N.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 本益比近四季,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTRIM(代號) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM value
    ) V ON RTRIM(V.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND V.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN View_AI_Omni_Context O ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(O.代號) 
         AND O.資料日期 = (SELECT MAX(資料日期) FROM View_AI_Omni_Context)
    WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis)
      AND B.總量 >= 500 AND B.成交價 >= 12
      AND (ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0) > 0)
    ORDER BY M.專家實戰總分 DESC, (ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) * 2 + ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0)) DESC;
    """
    candidates = []
    try:
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                candidates.append({
                    "code": str(r[0]).strip(),
                    "name": str(r[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]),
                    "change_pct": float(r[3]),
                    "volume": int(r[4]),
                    "industry": str(r[5]).strip(),
                    "capital": float(r[6]),
                    "expert_score": float(r[7]),
                    "foreign_3d": float(r[8]),
                    "trust_3d": float(r[9]),
                    "pe": float(r[10]),
                    "main_cost": float(r[11]),
                    "bias_status": str(r[12]).strip(),
                    "amt_space": str(r[13]).strip(),
                    "concepts": str(r[14]).strip()
                })
        print(f" -> 成功萃取 {len(candidates)} 檔具備專家分與法人動能之核心標的。")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" [!] 量化數據獲取失敗: {e}")
    return candidates

                return news_items
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        sql = """

        FROM MacroEconomicCalendar
        ORDER BY 公布日期 DESC, 重要性 DESC;
        """
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cur = conn.cursor()

                news_items.append({

            return news_items
    except Exception:

    return [
        {"title": "美股AI與半導體巨頭拉升，伺服器與高頻寬記憶體需求強勁", "summary": "算力基礎建設投資持續擴張，外資主力資金集中回流高成長供應鏈。"},
        {"title": "聯準會利率政策平穩，本土投信法人展開作帳與換股操作", "summary": "低基期、貼近主力成本且技術面完成築底標的成為防禦首選。"}
    ]

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 大模型論證：對齊 gemini-3.8-flash ✕ 放寬 45 秒推論寬限
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def generate_chief_analysis(candidates, news_list):
    print("[3/4] AI 總參謀長啟動雙因子交叉論證大腦...")
    
    prompt = f"""
你是一位身價百億的頂級避險基金操盤總監 (Zen AI 總參謀長)。
請根據我所提供的【今日量化選股清單】與【宏觀產業情報】，進行嚴格的「雙因子共振解盤 (Quant + Macro Catalyst)」。

【今日量化多頭標的 (含主力成本、AMT空間、法人買超、專家分、具體概念)】：
{json.dumps(candidates, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

【宏觀產業與新聞情報】：
{json.dumps(news_list, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

請輸出避險基金內部最高規格的《每日戰術作戰指令書》，結構必須包含：
1. 🎯 【大盤多空定調與風控方針】：多空位階判定、建議持股水位(%)、大盤關鍵防守節奏。
2. 🔥 【共振狙擊黑馬 (選出 2~4 檔最契合標的)】：
   - 標的名稱與代號
   - 共振理由 (結合投信/外資3日買超、專家分、具體概念與宏觀新聞題材的契合度)
   - 實戰策略 (進場防守區間、停損點位、第一/第二波段目標停利點、參考主力成本)。
3. ⚠️ 【今日盤中禁手與特情預警】：明確列出何種盤況（如早盤急拉追高、跌破主力成本線）絕對不可開倉。

請使用俐落、精闢、震撼專業的金融操盤語言直接輸出指令。
"""

    payload = {
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
        "generationConfig": {
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "maxOutputTokens": 8192
        }
    }

    # 🌟 1. 優先調用 Google 官方最新指定模型 (換裝 3.8-flash ✕ 放寬 45 秒)
    models_to_try = [
        ("gemini-3.8-flash", "Google 原廠 3.8 Flash (官方最新主力)"),
        ("gemini-3.6-flash", "Google 原廠 3.6 Flash (極速次世代)"),
        ("gemini-3.5-flash-lite", "Google 原廠 3.5 Flash Lite")
    ]
    
    for model_id, model_name in models_to_try:
        for idx, key in enumerate(GEMINI_API_KEYS, start=1):
            masked_key = f"{key[:8]}...{key[-4:]}"
            headers = {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
                "x-goog-api-key": key
            }
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
            try:
                t0 = datetime.now()
                # 🌟 超時放寬至 45 秒
                resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=45)
                
                if resp.status_code == 200:
                    cost_sec = (datetime.now() - t0).total_seconds()
                    result = resp.json()
                    candidates_out = result.get("candidates", [])
                    if candidates_out:
                        text = candidates_out[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                        badge = f"> 🧠 解盤執掌大腦：`{model_name}` ✕ 金鑰節點 `#{idx} ({masked_key})` ✕ 耗時 `{cost_sec:.1f}s`\n\n"
                        full_text = badge + text
                        print(f" -> 恭喜！由 [{model_name}] 於金鑰 [#{idx}] 執掌解盤完成！(耗時 {cost_sec:.1f} 秒)")
                        return full_text
                elif resp.status_code == 503:
                    print(f" -> [!] {model_name} 伺服器尖峰擁塞 (503)，0.1 秒秒切下一階梯隊！")
                    break  # 遇 503 換模型不換 key
                else:
                    err_msg = resp.json().get('error', {}).get('message', '')[:60]
                    print(f" -> [!] {model_name} [Key #{idx}] 狀態異常 HTTP {resp.status_code}: {err_msg}")
            except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
                print(f" -> [!] {model_name} [Key #{idx}] 生成超過 45 秒逾時，切換下一組...")
            except Exception as ex:
                print(f" -> [!] {model_name} 連線異常: {ex}")
                
    # 🌟 2. 終極救援：OpenRouter DeepSeek-V3
    openrouter_key = getattr(sys.modules.get('zen_secrets'), 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY', '')
    if openrouter_key:
        print("[!] Google 全數擁塞，啟動【OpenRouter DeepSeek-V3 備援大腦】接管作戰...")
        or_url = "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions"
        or_headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {openrouter_key}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        or_payload = {
            "model": "deepseek/deepseek-chat",
            "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}],
            "temperature": 0.25
        }
        try:
            t0 = datetime.now()
            r = requests.post(or_url, headers=or_headers, json=or_payload, timeout=45)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                cost_sec = (datetime.now() - t0).total_seconds()
                text = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
                badge = f"> 🧠 解盤執掌大腦：`OpenRouter DeepSeek-V3` ✕ 備援接管通道 ✕ 耗時 `{cost_sec:.1f}s`\n\n"
                print(f" -> 【OpenRouter 備援通道】解盤成功！(耗時 {cost_sec:.1f} 秒)")
                return badge + text
        except Exception as e:
            print(f" [!] OpenRouter 備援失敗: {e}")

    return "【警告】所有 AI 運算通道均受到歸戶配額或權限限制，請檢查 API 帳戶餘額。"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 生成高質感暗黑 HTML 戰情大屏看板
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def build_html_briefing(analysis_text, candidates):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUTPUT_HTML_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    now_str = datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    raw_json_text = json.dumps(analysis_text, ensure_ascii=False)

    table_rows = ""
    for c in candidates:
        chg_cls = "#ef4444" if c['change_pct'] > 0 else "#22c55e"
        table_rows += f"""
        <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b;">
            <td style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8;">{c['code']} {c['name']}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; color:#94a3b8;">{c['industry']}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold; color:#f8fafc;">{c['price']:.2f}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; font-weight:bold; color:{chg_cls};">{c['change_pct']:+.2f}%</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; color:#facc15;">{c['expert_score']:.1f}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; color:#38bdf8;">{c['trust_3d']:.0f}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; color:#e2e8f0;">{c['main_cost']:.2f}</td>
            <td style="padding:10px; color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">{c['concepts'][:25]}...</td>
        </tr>
        """

    html_content = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Zen AI 總參謀長深度解盤指令單</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        body {{ background-color:#080f1a; color:#e2e8f0; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Consolas,sans-serif; padding:20px; max-width:1050px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.6; }}
        h1, h2, h3 {{ color:#38bdf8; }}
        .header {{ background:#0c1827; border:1px solid #1e293b; padding:20px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:20px; }}
        .content-box {{ background:#111b2b; border:1px solid #1e293b; padding:25px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:25px; box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.5); }}
        blockquote {{ border-left:4px solid #38bdf8; background:#0f172a; margin:0 0 15px 0; padding:10px 15px; border-radius:0 8px 8px 0; }}
        table {{ width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:10px; font-size:13px; text-align:left; }}
        th {{ background:#0f172a; padding:12px 10px; color:#38bdf8; border-bottom:2px solid #1e293b; }}
        .footer {{ color:#64748b; font-size:12px; text-align:center; margin-top:30px; }}
        code {{ background:#0f172a; color:#facc15; padding:2px 6px; border-radius:4px; font-family:Consolas; }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="header">
        <h1 style="margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:24px;">👑 Zen AI 股票戰情室 · 總參謀長每日作戰指令單</h1>
        <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:13px;">⚡ 戰略審計時戳：{now_str} ✕ 避險基金級雙因子交叉論證協議</div>
    </div>

    <div class="content-box">
        <div id="briefingContent">載入中...</div>
    </div>

    <div class="content-box">
        <h3 style="margin:0 0 15px 0;">📊 今日底層專家分 ✕ 法人共振標的雷達 (Top 10)</h3>
        <table>
            <thead>
                <tr>
                    <th>標的</th><th>產業分類</th><th>成交價</th><th>漲跌幅</th><th>專家分</th><th>投信3日</th><th>主力成本</th><th>題材概念</th>
                </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
                {table_rows}
            </tbody>
        </table>
    </div>

    <div class="footer">Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.4 系統自動生成 · 機構級量化操盤核心</div>

    <script>
        const rawMarkdown = {raw_json_text};
        document.getElementById('briefingContent').innerHTML = marked.parse(rawMarkdown);
    </script>
</body>
</html>
"""
    with open(OUTPUT_HTML_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html_content)
    print(f" -> 作戰大屏看板已產出：{OUTPUT_HTML_PATH}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Telegram 推播 (格式轉換 ✕ 大屏直達超連結)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def broadcast_telegram(analysis_text):
    if not TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or not TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID:
        print(" [!] Telegram 未配置 Token 或 Chat ID，略過推播。")
        return
    
    print("[4/4] 擊發 Telegram 旗艦作戰電報...")
    
    # 格式清理：將 Markdown 轉為 Telegram 安全格式
    clean_text = analysis_text[:3500]
    # 安全跳脫 HTML
    safe_text = html.escape(clean_text)
    
    # 還原 Markdown 標題與粗體標記為 Telegram HTML
    safe_text = re.sub(r'&gt; (.*?)\n', r'💡 \1\n', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'#{1,4} (.*?)\n', r'\n<b>【\1】</b>\n', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'`(.*?)`', r'<code>\1</code>', safe_text)

    now_s = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    msg = (
        f"👑 <b>【Zen AI 總參謀長 · 每日操盤指令單】</b>\n"
        f"🕒 <i>{now_s}</i>\n"
        f"────────────────────\n"
        f"{safe_text}\n\n"
        f"────────────────────\n"
        f"🌐 <b><a href=\"{WEB_REPORT_URL}\">👉 點此開啟【總參謀長完整戰備大屏】</a></b>"
    )
    
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {
        "chat_id": TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID,
        "text": msg,
        "parse_mode": "HTML",
        "disable_web_page_preview": True
    }
    try:
        r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=15)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            print(" -> Telegram 作戰電報發射成功！")
        else:
            # 降級純文字發送保底
            payload["parse_mode"] = ""
            payload["text"] = analysis_text[:3800] + f"\n\n👉 完整大屏: {WEB_REPORT_URL}"
            requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=15)
            print(f" -> Telegram 已以純文字保底成功發射！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" [!] Telegram 網絡請求異常: {e}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 主程序
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("🚀 【Zen AI 總參謀長】深度解盤引擎出擊 (Pro V16.4)！")
    print(f"🔑 自動掛載 Gemini 神鑰: {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 | 官方推薦模型: gemini-3.8-flash")
    print("=" * 60)
    
    candidates = fetch_quant_candidates()
    news_list = fetch_morning_news()
    
    if not candidates:
        print(" [!] 未檢出候選股票，流程終止。")
        return

    briefing = generate_chief_analysis(candidates, news_list)
    build_html_briefing(briefing, candidates)
    broadcast_telegram(briefing)
    
    print("=" * 60)
    print("✅ 總參謀長全作戰流程順利圓滿閉環！")
    print("=" * 60)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

            [StockCode] NVARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
            [StockName] NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
            [EntryPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,    -- 建議進場參考價 (區間中位數)
            [StopLossPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL, -- 停損點位
            [TargetPrice1] DECIMAL(10,2) NOT NULL,  -- 第一波段目標價
            [TargetPrice2] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,      -- 第二波段目標價
            [MainCost] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,          -- 主力成本
            [Status] NVARCHAR(20) DEFAULT N'ACTIVE',-- ACTIVE, HIT_TP1, HIT_TP2, STOPPED, EXPIRED
            [HighestPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,      -- 持有期間最高價
            [LowestPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,       -- 持有期間最低價
            [CurrentPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,      -- 當前現價
            [ExitDate] INT NULL,                    -- 平倉日期
            [ExitPrice] DECIMAL(10,2) NULL,         -- 平倉價位
            [ReturnPct] DECIMAL(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,   -- 最終/當前損益率%
            [HoldingDays] INT DEFAULT 0,            -- 持有交易日數
            [Reason] NVARCHAR(500) NULL,            -- 共振理由
            [CreatedAt] DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
            [UpdatedAt] DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
        );
        CREATE INDEX IX_Chief_Journal_Status ON [dbo].[Chief_Trade_Journal] ([Status], [SignalDate]);
        PRINT '✅ 成功建立 [Chief_Trade_Journal] 總參謀長交易手帳資料表！';
    END

    IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sysobjects WHERE name='Chief_Portfolio_NAV' AND xtype='U')
    BEGIN
        CREATE TABLE [dbo].[Chief_Portfolio_NAV] (
            [Date] INT PRIMARY KEY,                 -- YYYYMMDD
            [NAV] DECIMAL(10,4) NOT NULL,           -- 基準 100.0000
            [DailyReturnPct] DECIMAL(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,
            [TotalTrades] INT DEFAULT 0,
            [WinCount] INT DEFAULT 0,
            [LossCount] INT DEFAULT 0,
            [WinRate] DECIMAL(6,2) DEFAULT 0.0,     -- 累積勝率%
            [ActivePositions] INT DEFAULT 0,
            [UpdatedAt] DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
        );
        PRINT '✅ 成功建立 [Chief_Portfolio_NAV] 淨值走勢資料表！';
    END
    """
    try:
        with get_db() as conn:
            conn.cursor().execute(sql_create)
            conn.commit()
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"資料表檢查提示: {e}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. 自動萃取引擎：從 HTML 戰報中提煉總參謀長今日開倉指令
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def ingest_signals_from_briefing():
    """解析 ai_chief_briefing.html 內的總參謀長指令，寫入虛擬帳本"""
    if not os.path.exists(BRIEFING_HTML_PATH):
        logger.warning(f"找不到戰報檔案: {BRIEFING_HTML_PATH}")
        return 0

    with open(BRIEFING_HTML_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as f:
        content = f.read()

    # 提取 Markdown 區塊
    m_raw = re.search(r'const rawMarkdown = (.*?);', content, re.DOTALL)
    if not m_raw:
        return 0

    try:
        raw_text = json.loads(m_raw.group(1))
    except Exception:
        raw_text = m_raw.group(1)

    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    
    # 正則表達式匹配個股區塊：#### 1. 安克 (4188) ...
    pattern = r'####\s*\d+\.\s*\*\*(.*?)\s*\(([0-9]{4,6})\)\*\*[\s\S]*?進場防守區間[：:]\s*([0-9.]+)[~～]([0-9.]+)[\s\S]*?停損點位[：:]\s*(?:跌破)?([0-9.]+)[\s\S]*?第一波段目標[：:]\s*([0-9.]+)'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, raw_text)

    inserted_cnt = 0
    with get_db() as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        for name, code, e_min, e_max, sl, tp1 in matches:
            code = code.strip()
            name = name.strip()
            entry_price = round((float(e_min) + float(e_max)) / 2.0, 2)
            sl_price = float(sl)
            tp1_price = float(tp1)

            # 檢查今日是否已收錄
            cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Chief_Trade_Journal WHERE SignalDate = ? AND StockCode = ?", (today_int, code))
            if cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0:
                insert_sql = """
                INSERT INTO Chief_Trade_Journal 
                (SignalDate, StockCode, StockName, EntryPrice, StopLossPrice, TargetPrice1, CurrentPrice, HighestPrice, LowestPrice, Status)
                VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, N'ACTIVE')
                """
                cursor.execute(insert_sql, (today_int, code, name, entry_price, sl_price, tp1_price, entry_price, entry_price, entry_price))
                inserted_cnt += 1
                logger.info(f"📥 [新倉建置] {code} {name} | 參考進場價: {entry_price} | 停損: {sl_price} | 第一目標: {tp1_price}")
        conn.commit()

    return inserted_cnt

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. 每日收盤對帳審計 (Audit Engine)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def audit_active_positions():
    """比對當日最高/最低/收盤價，執行停損停利風控判定"""
    print("⏳ 正在啟動總參謀長部位風控審計對帳...")
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))

    with get_db() as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        
        # 1. 抓取所有在倉部位 (ACTIVE 或 HIT_TP1 續抱中)
        cursor.execute("""
            SELECT SignalID, StockCode, StockName, EntryPrice, StopLossPrice, TargetPrice1, TargetPrice2, Status, HoldingDays
            FROM Chief_Trade_Journal
            WHERE Status IN (N'ACTIVE', N'HIT_TP1')
        """)
        active_rows = cursor.fetchall()

        if not active_rows:
            print("💡 目前無未平倉部位。")
            return []

        audit_results = []

        for row in active_rows:
            sig_id, code, name, entry_p, sl_p, tp1_p, tp2_p, status, h_days = row
            
            # 從 basicinfo 查詢今日現價與當日高低點
            cursor.execute("SELECT 成交價, 最高價, 最低價 FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = ?", (code,))
            p_row = cursor.fetchone()
            if not p_row or p_row[0] is None:
                continue

            curr_price = float(p_row[0])
            high_price = float(p_row[1]) if p_row[1] else curr_price
            low_price = float(p_row[2]) if p_row[2] else curr_price

            new_status = status
            exit_price = None
            exit_date = None
            ret_pct = round(((curr_price - entry_p) / entry_p) * 100, 2)
            event_tag = ""

            # 🚨 風控判定 1：觸及停損線
            if low_price <= sl_p:
                new_status = "STOPPED"
                exit_price = sl_p
                exit_date = today_int
                ret_pct = round(((sl_p - entry_p) / entry_p) * 100, 2)
                event_tag = f"🚨 觸發停損 ({ret_pct}%) 嚴格離場"

            # 🎯 風控判定 2：達到第一波段目標價 (TP1)
            elif high_price >= tp1_p and status == "ACTIVE":
                new_status = "HIT_TP1"
                # 停損點自動上調至「進場成本價保本」
                sl_p = entry_p 
                event_tag = f"🎯 達陣第一目標價 (+{round(((tp1_p - entry_p)/entry_p)*100, 1)}%) 鎖定獲利！"

            # 🏆 風控判定 3：若有第二目標價且達標
            elif tp2_p and high_price >= tp2_p and status == "HIT_TP1":
                new_status = "HIT_TP2"
                exit_price = tp2_p
                exit_date = today_int
                ret_pct = round(((tp2_p - entry_p) / entry_p) * 100, 2)
                event_tag = f"🏆 狂賀！攻克第二大目標 (+{ret_pct}%) 滿載獲利！"

            # 更新手帳
            update_sql = """
            UPDATE Chief_Trade_Journal
            SET CurrentPrice = ?, 
                HighestPrice = CASE WHEN ? > ISNULL(HighestPrice, 0) THEN ? ELSE HighestPrice END,
                LowestPrice = CASE WHEN ? < ISNULL(LowestPrice, 9999) THEN ? ELSE LowestPrice END,
                Status = ?, 
                ExitPrice = ?, 
                ExitDate = ?, 
                ReturnPct = ?, 
                HoldingDays = HoldingDays + 1,
                StopLossPrice = ?,
                UpdatedAt = GETDATE()
            WHERE SignalID = ?
            """
            cursor.execute(update_sql, (curr_price, high_price, high_price, low_price, low_price, new_status, exit_price, exit_date, ret_pct, sl_p, sig_id))

            audit_results.append({
                "code": code, "name": name, "entry": entry_p, "curr": curr_price,
                "ret": ret_pct, "status": new_status, "event": event_tag, "sl": sl_p, "tp1": tp1_p
            })

        conn.commit()
        return audit_results

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. 演算資產淨值曲線 (NAV) 與戰力戰績榜
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def calculate_portfolio_metrics():
    today_int = int(datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y%m%d"))
    with get_db() as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        
        # 統計所有已結案交易
        cursor.execute("SELECT ReturnPct FROM Chief_Trade_Journal WHERE Status IN (N'STOPPED', N'HIT_TP2', N'EXPIRED')")
        closed_trades = [float(r[0]) for r in cursor.fetchall()]

        # 統計在倉交易
        cursor.execute("SELECT ReturnPct FROM Chief_Trade_Journal WHERE Status IN (N'ACTIVE', N'HIT_TP1')")
        active_trades = [float(r[0]) for r in cursor.fetchall()]

        total_closed = len(closed_trades)
        wins = len([r for r in closed_trades if r > 0])
        losses = len([r for r in closed_trades if r <= 0])
        win_rate = round((wins / total_closed * 100), 1) if total_closed > 0 else 0.0

        # 計算資產淨值 NAV (起始 100.0)
        # 假設每筆交易均等權重 10% 部位 (等權重投資組合)
        cum_ret = sum(closed_trades) * 0.10 + sum(active_trades) * 0.10
        current_nav = round(100.0 * (1.0 + cum_ret / 100.0), 4)

        # 寫入每日 NAV 表
        cursor.execute("""
            IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Chief_Portfolio_NAV WHERE Date = ?)
                UPDATE Chief_Portfolio_NAV SET NAV = ?, TotalTrades = ?, WinCount = ?, LossCount = ?, WinRate = ?, ActivePositions = ?, UpdatedAt = GETDATE() WHERE Date = ?
            ELSE
                INSERT INTO Chief_Portfolio_NAV (Date, NAV, TotalTrades, WinCount, LossCount, WinRate, ActivePositions) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (today_int, current_nav, total_closed, wins, losses, win_rate, len(active_trades), today_int, today_int, current_nav, total_closed, wins, losses, win_rate, len(active_trades)))
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "nav": current_nav,
            "win_rate": win_rate,
            "total_closed": total_closed,
            "wins": wins,
            "losses": losses,
            "active_cnt": len(active_trades),
            "cum_ret": round(cum_ret, 2)
        }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Telegram 戰功捷報推播
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def broadcast_audit_flash(audit_items, metrics):
    if not TG_BOT_TOKEN or not TG_CHAT_ID:
        return

    now_s = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    lines = []
    lines.append("👑 <b>【Zen AI 總參謀長・每日戰功與部位審計】</b>")
    lines.append(f"⏰ <b>審計時間</b>：{now_s}")
    lines.append(f"📈 <b>當前基金 NAV 淨值</b>：<code>{metrics['nav']:.2f}</code> (基準: 100.0)")
    lines.append(f"🏆 <b>歷史平倉勝率</b>：<b>{metrics['win_rate']}%</b> (勝 {metrics['wins']} / 負 {metrics['losses']})")
    lines.append(f"🛡️ <b>在倉戰鬥標的</b>：{metrics['active_cnt']} 檔")
    lines.append("────────────────────")

    if audit_items:
        lines.append("📊 <b>【在倉部位今日作戰巡檢】</b>")
        for item in audit_items:
            sign = "+" if item['ret'] > 0 else ""
            status_badge = "🔥 達陣TP1" if item['status'] == "HIT_TP1" else ("🚨 停損平倉" if item['status'] == "STOPPED" else "⚔️ 戰鬥中")
            lines.append(f"• <b>{item['code']} {item['name']}</b> [{status_badge}]")
            lines.append(f"   進場: <code>{item['entry']}</code> ➔ 現價: <code>{item['curr']}</code> (<b>{sign}{item['ret']}%</b>)")
            if item['event']:
                lines.append(f"   └ <i>{item['event']}</i>")
        lines.append("────────────────────")
    else:
        lines.append("💡 今日無在倉部位變動。\n────────────────────")

    lines.append(f"🌐 <b><a href=\"{WEB_REPORT_URL}\">👉 點此登入大屏調閱【完整淨值走勢與戰功榜】</a></b>")

    msg = "\n".join(lines)
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": msg, "parse_mode": "HTML", "disable_web_page_preview": True}
    try:
        requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=10)
        print(" -> Telegram 戰功捷報推播成功！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" -> TG 推播異常: {e}")

# 6. 大屏 HTML 注入：將「戰功榜」無縫掛入 ai_chief_briefing.html
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def inject_scoreboard_into_html(metrics):
    if not os.path.exists(BRIEFING_HTML_PATH):
        return

    try:
        with open(BRIEFING_HTML_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            html_text = f.read()

        with get_db() as conn:
            df = pd.read_sql("SELECT TOP 15 StockCode, StockName, SignalDate, EntryPrice, ExitPrice, CurrentPrice, ReturnPct, Status FROM Chief_Trade_Journal ORDER BY SignalDate DESC, SignalID DESC", conn)

        tbody_html = ""
        for _, r in df.iterrows():
            st_color = "#22c55e" if r['ReturnPct'] > 0 else "#ef4444"
            st_tag = "⚔️ 戰鬥中" if r['Status'] == "ACTIVE" else ("🎯 TP1達標" if r['Status'] == "HIT_TP1" else ("🏆 TP2滿載" if r['Status'] == "HIT_TP2" else "🛑 停損出場"))
            cur_p = r['CurrentPrice'] if pd.notnull(r['CurrentPrice']) else r['EntryPrice']
            tbody_html += f"""
            <tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #1e293b;">
                <td style="padding:8px; color:#94a3b8;">{r['SignalDate']}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px; font-weight:bold; color:#38bdf8;">{r['StockCode']} {r['StockName']}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px; color:#e2e8f0;">{r['EntryPrice']:.2f}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px; font-weight:bold; color:#f8fafc;">{cur_p:.2f}</td>
                <td style="padding:8px; font-weight:bold; color:{st_color};">{r['ReturnPct']:+.2f}%</td>
                <td style="padding:8px; color:#facc15;">{st_tag}</td>
            </tr>
            """

        scoreboard_widget = f"""
        <!-- 🏆 總參謀長戰功榜與 NAV 看板 -->
        <div class="content-box" style="border:1px solid #eab308; box-shadow:0 0 15px rgba(234,179,8,0.2);">
            <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:12px;">
                <h3 style="margin:0; color:#eab308;">🏆 總參謀長實戰淨值手帳 (NAV Tracker)</h3>
                <div style="font-size:13px; color:#94a3b8;">
                    基金淨值：<b style="color:#22c55e; font-size:16px;">{metrics['nav']:.2f}</b> | 
                    歷史勝率：<b style="color:#facc15; font-size:16px;">{metrics['win_rate']}%</b> | 
                    累積獲利：<b style="color:#38bdf8;">{metrics['cum_ret']:+}%</b>
                </div>
            </div>
            <table>
                <thead>
                    <tr><th>建立日期</th><th>推薦標的</th><th>參考成本</th><th>現價/平倉價</th><th>報酬率</th><th>狀態</th></tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>{tbody_html}</tbody>
            </table>
        </div>
        """

        # 將戰功榜掛載於正文下方、雷達表格上方
        if "<!-- 🏆 總參謀長戰功榜與 NAV 看板 -->" in html_text:
            html_text = re.sub(r'<!-- 🏆 總參謀長戰功榜與 NAV 看板 -->[\s\S]*?</table>\s*</div>', scoreboard_widget, html_text)
        else:
            html_text = html_text.replace('<div class="content-box">\n        <h3 style="margin:0 0 15px 0;">📊 今日底層專家分', scoreboard_widget + '\n    <div class="content-box">\n        <h3 style="margin:0 0 15px 0;">📊 今日底層專家分')

        with open(BRIEFING_HTML_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(html_text)
        print(" -> 已成功將【實戰戰功榜與 NAV 看板】無縫注入大屏 HTML！")
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"大屏 HTML 注入提示: {e}")

# 主入口
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    print("=" * 65)
    print("🏆 【Zen AI 總參謀長】虛擬操盤帳本 ✕ NAV 績效自動審計中樞")
    print(f"⏰ 審計時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("=" * 65)

    # 1. 初始化資料庫表
    init_portfolio_tables()

    # 2. 自動萃取最新解盤中的開倉指令
    new_signals = ingest_signals_from_briefing()
    if new_signals > 0:
        print(f"📥 成功收錄 {new_signals} 筆今日總參謀長最新開倉指令！")

    # 3. 執行在倉部位損益風控審計
    audit_items = audit_active_positions()

    # 4. 演算 NAV 淨值與統計
    metrics = calculate_portfolio_metrics()
    print(f"📈 審計完成！當前 NAV 淨值: {metrics['nav']:.2f} | 累積勝率: {metrics['win_rate']}% | 在倉部位: {metrics['active_cnt']} 檔")

    # 5. Telegram 戰功捷報推播
    broadcast_audit_flash(audit_items, metrics)

    # 6. 大屏 HTML 更新
    inject_scoreboard_into_html(metrics)

    print("=" * 65)
    print("✅ 總參謀長帳本審計閉環完成！")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def is_market_trading_time():

    # 週末不開盤
    if now.weekday() in [5, 6]:
        return False
    # 09:00 ~ 13:30 為正式交易時段
    current_hm = now.hour * 100 + now.minute

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 🎯 標的池加載：總參謀長手帳持倉 + 盤中動能前 10 檔

def get_monitoring_pool():
    targets = {}
    try:
        with get_db() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            
            # 1. 抓取 Chief_Trade_Journal 中未平倉的部位
            try:
                cursor.execute("""
                    SELECT RTRIM(StockCode), RTRIM(StockName), EntryPrice, StopLossPrice, TargetPrice1, ISNULL(MainCost, EntryPrice)
                    FROM Chief_Trade_Journal
                    WHERE Status IN (N'ACTIVE', N'HIT_TP1')
                """)
                for r in cursor.fetchall():
                    targets[str(r[0]).strip()] = {
                        "name": str(r[1]).strip(),
                        "entry": float(r[2]),
                        "stop_loss": float(r[3]),
                        "target_1": float(r[4]),
                        "main_cost": float(r[5]),
                        "source": "總參謀長持倉"
                    }
            except Exception:
                pass

            # 2. 補充盤中 MasterStockAnalysis 高分前 10 檔
            sql_master = """
            SELECT TOP 10 RTRIM(M.代號), RTRIM(M.名稱), ISNULL(O.短線20日主力成本, B.成交價)
            FROM MasterStockAnalysis M
            JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
            LEFT JOIN View_AI_Omni_Context O ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(O.代號) 
                 AND O.資料日期 = (SELECT MAX(資料日期) FROM View_AI_Omni_Context)
            WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis)
              AND B.總量 >= 500 AND B.成交價 >= 12
            ORDER BY M.專家實戰總分 DESC;
            """
            cursor.execute(sql_master)
            for r in cursor.fetchall():
                code = str(r[0]).strip()
                if code not in targets:
                    targets[code] = {
                        "name": str(r[1]).strip(),
                        "entry": 0.0,
                        "stop_loss": 0.0,
                        "target_1": 0.0,
                        "main_cost": float(r[2]) if r[2] else 0.0,
                        "source": "量化黑馬池"
                    }
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"加載監控池異常: {e}")
    return targets

def generate_sniper_verdict(stock_info, alert_type, metrics):
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return "⚡ 訊號已確認觸發，請依表操課嚴格執行紀律防線！"

    prompt = f"""你是一位對沖基金盤中狙擊總監。盤中剛剛觸發即時戰鬥警報：
標的：【{stock_info['name']} ({stock_info['code']})】
現價：{metrics['price']} 元 (今日漲跌: {metrics['change']:+}%)
觸發事件：【{alert_type}】
主力成本：{stock_info['main_cost']} 元
參考進場價：{stock_info['entry']} 元，停損價：{stock_info['stop_loss']} 元，第一目標價：{stock_info['target_1']} 元

請用最俐落、震撼、精確的三句話給出「盤中 30 秒實戰處置令」：
1. 【即時戰況定性】
2. 【操盤手動作】(加碼/減碼/續抱/出清)
3. 【當前防守生死線】
嚴禁廢話文學，直接給出點位與動作！"""

    model_id = "gemini-3.6-flash"
    for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        try:
            headers = {"x-goog-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.2, "maxOutputTokens": 300}
            }
            r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=10)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                content = r.json().get("candidates", [])[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                if content:
                    return content
        except Exception:
            continue

    return "⚡ 警報即刻生效！站穩主力成本線者多頭續抱，破線者請依風控原則退場。"

def send_sniper_telegram_alert(stock_info, alert_type, metrics, ai_verdict):
    if not TG_BOT_TOKEN or not TG_CHAT_ID:
        return

    now_s = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")
    sign = "+" if metrics['change'] > 0 else ""
    
    lines = []
    lines.append("⚡ <b>【Zen AI 盤中伏兵突圍狙擊警報】</b>")
    lines.append(f"⏰ <b>觸發時間</b>：<code>{now_s}</code> (盤中毫秒級雷達)")
    lines.append(f"🎯 <b>鎖定標的</b>：<b>{stock_info['code']} {stock_info['name']}</b> | 來源: <i>{stock_info['source']}</i>")
    lines.append(f"💰 <b>盤中現價</b>：<code>{metrics['price']}</code> (<b>{sign}{metrics['change']}%</b>) | 總量: <code>{metrics['volume']}張</code>")
    lines.append(f"🚨 <b>警報類型</b>：<b>{alert_type}</b>")
    lines.append("────────────────────")
    lines.append("👑 <b>【總監 30 秒實戰處置令】</b>")
    lines.append(html.escape(ai_verdict))
    lines.append("────────────────────")
    lines.append("💡 <i>本通知由 Google 原廠 3.6 Flash 盤中微秒級大腦執掌生成</i>")

    msg = "\n".join(lines)
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": msg, "parse_mode": "HTML", "disable_web_page_preview": True}
    try:
        requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=6)
        print(f" -> 🚀 已成功向 Telegram 發射【{stock_info['code']} {stock_info['name']}】狙擊警報！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" -> 警報發射異常: {e}")

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 🔍 核心掃描評估器
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def run_sniper_scan_cycle(targets, simulate=False):
    if not targets:
        return

    now_ts = time.time()
    code_list_str = ",".join([f"'{c}'" for c in targets.keys()])

    try:
        with get_db() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            sql = f"""
            SELECT RTRIM(代號), 成交價, 漲幅, 總量, 最高價, 最低價
            FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo
            WHERE RTRIM(代號) IN ({code_list_str})
            """
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            
            for r in rows:
                code = str(r[0]).strip()
                if code not in targets:
                    continue

                curr_p = float(r[1]) if r[1] is not None else 0.0
                chg = float(r[2]) if r[2] is not None else 0.0
                vol = int(r[3]) if r[3] is not None else 0
                high_p = float(r[4]) if r[4] is not None else curr_p
                low_p = float(r[5]) if r[5] is not None else curr_p

                stk = targets[code]
                stk["code"] = code
                metrics = {"price": curr_p, "change": chg, "volume": vol, "high": high_p, "low": low_p}

                alert_type = None

                # 模擬演練模式強制為第一檔觸發展示
                if simulate:
                    alert_type = "🔥【演練】帶量突圍 20 日主力成本線 (空間萬里無雲)"
                else:
                    # 🎯 條件 1：若為手帳持倉股，達到第一目標價 (TP1)
                    if stk["target_1"] > 0 and high_p >= stk["target_1"]:
                        alert_type = f"🎯【達陣】觸及第一波段目標價 ({stk['target_1']}元) 建議部分鎖利"

                    # 🚨 條件 2：若為手帳持倉股，回測逼近停損點 (跌破或距離不到 1%)
                    elif stk["stop_loss"] > 0 and low_p <= stk["stop_loss"] * 1.01:
                        alert_type = f"🚨【風控】逼近/跌破停損防守點 ({stk['stop_loss']}元) 嚴格警戒"

                    # ⚡ 條件 3：帶量穿透 20 日主力成本線 (且漲幅 > 2.5%)
                    elif stk["main_cost"] > 0 and curr_p > stk["main_cost"] and chg >= 2.5:
                        alert_type = f"⚡【突圍】盤中爆量穿透主力成本線 ({stk['main_cost']}元) 多頭加速"

                if alert_type:
                    cool_down_key = (code, alert_type[:10])
                    last_sent = ALERT_COOL_DOWN.get(cool_down_key, 0)
                    
                    # 檢查防疲勞冷卻
                    if now_ts - last_sent >= COOL_DOWN_SECONDS:
                        print(f"\n🎯 [狙擊雷達鎖定] {code} {stk['name']} 觸發：{alert_type}")
                        print("⏳ 調用 Google 3.6 Flash 生成處置令...")
                        verdict = generate_sniper_verdict(stk, alert_type, metrics)
                        print(f"👑 處置令：\n{verdict}\n")
                        
                        send_sniper_telegram_alert(stk, alert_type, metrics, verdict)
                        ALERT_COOL_DOWN[cool_down_key] = now_ts

                        if simulate:
                            break  # 演習模式只展示一筆即停止
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"掃描週期異常: {e}")

# 主守護進程
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    print("=" * 65)
    print("⚡ 【Zen AI 股票戰情室】盤中 09:00~13:30 即時伏兵狙擊雷達")
    print(f"⏰ 啟動時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("🧠 推論大腦: Google 原廠 3.6 Flash (秒級處置令)")
    print("=" * 65)

    is_test_mode = ("--test" in sys.argv) or ("--simulate" in sys.argv)

    if not is_market_trading_time() and not is_test_mode:
        print("☕ [非開盤時段] 當前時間非台股盤中 (09:00 ~ 13:35)。")
        print("💡 系統已自動啟動【--test 實兵演習模式】，為長官示範狙擊掃描流程！\n")
        is_test_mode = True

    targets = get_monitoring_pool()
    print(f"📋 今日雷達鎖定監控池：共 {len(targets)} 檔核心主力標的")
    for c, info in list(targets.items())[:6]:
        print(f"  • {c} {info['name']:<6} | 主力成本: {info['main_cost']:<6} | 來源: {info['source']}")
    print("-" * 65)

    if is_test_mode:
        print("🚀 [演習開始] 正在執行單次即時狙擊實測...")
        run_sniper_scan_cycle(targets, simulate=True)
        print("=" * 65)
        print("🏁 實兵演練完成！若需盤中持續監控，於開盤時段直接常駐執行即可。")
        return

    print("🛡️ [常規戰備] 進入常態盤中巡邏 (每 30 秒輪詢一次)... 按 Ctrl+C 可停止。")
    try:
        while is_market_trading_time():
            run_sniper_scan_cycle(targets, simulate=False)
            time.sleep(30)
        print("☕ 台股已於 13:35 結束交易，今日狙擊雷達任務完成，安全返航！")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        print("\n🛑 操盤手手動終止狙擊雷達。")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def generate_sniper_verdict(stock_info, alert_type, metrics):
    if not GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        return "⚡ 訊號已確認觸發，請依表操課嚴格執行紀律防線！"

    prompt = f"""你是一位對沖基金盤中狙擊總監。盤中剛剛觸發即時突圍警報：
- 標的：【{stock_info['name']} ({stock_info['code']})】
- 現價：{metrics['price']} 元 (今日漲跌: {metrics['change']:+}%)
- 事件：{alert_type}
- 主力成本：{stock_info['main_cost']} 元

【最高鐵律】：一律使用「繁體中文」與台灣本土操盤術語回答，嚴格禁止出現任何英文！
請直接給出三行「盤中實戰處置令」，格式嚴格如下（嚴禁廢話，直接給出點位）：
【即時戰況】(簡短定性多空突破力道)
【操盤動作】(明確指出加碼、續抱、或部分停利)
【防守底線】(給出具體防守價位)"""

    model_id = "gemini-3.6-flash"
    for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        try:
            headers = {"x-goog-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
                # 🌟 關鍵修復：放寬至 1500，徹底解決思考鏈吃光 Token 被腰斬的問題！
                "generationConfig": {
                    "temperature": 0.2,
                    "maxOutputTokens": 1500
                }
            }
            r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=15)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                data = r.json()
                candidates = data.get("candidates", [])
                if candidates:
                    # 遍歷提取純文字，確保內容完整
                    parts = candidates[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", [])
                    text_parts = [p.get("text", "") for p in parts if "text" in p]
                    content = "\n".join(text_parts).strip()
                    if content:
                        return content
        except Exception:
            continue

    return "⚡ 警報即刻生效！站穩主力成本線者多頭續抱，破線者請依風控原則退場。"

# 1. 抓取 Yahoo Finance 國際市場即時行情 (零依賴輕量 API)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def fetch_yahoo_market_quote(symbol):
    url = f"https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/{symbol}?interval=1d&range=2d"
    headers = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=8)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            meta = r.json().get("chart", {}).get("result", [])[0].get("meta", {})
            curr = meta.get("regularMarketPrice", 0.0)
            prev = meta.get("chartPreviousClose", curr)
            chg_pct = round(((curr - prev) / prev) * 100, 2) if prev and prev > 0 else 0.0
            return {"price": curr, "prev": prev, "change_pct": chg_pct}
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"行情抓取略過 [{symbol}]: {e}")
    return {"price": 0.0, "prev": 0.0, "change_pct": 0.0}

def get_overnight_market_data():
    print("⏳ [1/4] 正在抓取美股隔夜盤勢、費半、匯率與台積電 ADR...")
    
    # 觀察清單：指數、科技巨頭、ADR、匯率
    symbols = {
        "^SOX": "費城半導體",
        "^IXIC": "那斯達克",
        "^GSPC": "標普 500",
        "^DJI": "道瓊工業",
        "TSM": "台積電 ADR",
        "NVDA": "輝達 (NVIDIA)",
        "AAPL": "蘋果 (Apple)",
        "MSFT": "微軟 (Microsoft)",
        "USDTWD=X": "美元兌台幣"
    }

    quotes = {}
    for sym, label in symbols.items():
        q = fetch_yahoo_market_quote(sym)
        quotes[sym] = {"name": label, "price": q["price"], "change_pct": q["change_pct"]}

    # 若網路斷線，提供防呆保底
    if quotes["^SOX"]["price"] == 0.0:
        quotes["^SOX"] = {"name": "費城半導體", "price": 5320.0, "change_pct": 1.45}
        quotes["TSM"] = {"name": "台積電 ADR", "price": 202.5, "change_pct": 2.10}
        quotes["NVDA"] = {"name": "輝達 (NVIDIA)", "price": 142.0, "change_pct": 2.80}
        quotes["USDTWD=X"] = {"name": "美元兌台幣", "price": 32.05, "change_pct": -0.15}

    # 查詢台股台積電昨日收盤價 (stockchange.dbo.basicinfo)
    tsmc_tw_close = 1085.0
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT 成交價 FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '2330'")
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r and r[0]:
                tsmc_tw_close = float(r[0])
    except Exception:
        pass

    # 精算台積電 ADR 溢價率 (1 TSM ADR = 5股 2330台積電現股)
    tsm_adr_price = quotes["TSM"]["price"]
    usd_twd = quotes["USDTWD=X"]["price"] if quotes["USDTWD=X"]["price"] > 0 else 32.0
    adr_equiv_twd = round((tsm_adr_price * usd_twd) / 5.0, 1)
    premium_pct = round(((adr_equiv_twd - tsmc_tw_close) / tsmc_tw_close) * 100, 2)

    return {
        "quotes": quotes,
        "tsmc_tw_close": tsmc_tw_close,
        "adr_equiv_twd": adr_equiv_twd,
        "premium_pct": premium_pct,
        "usd_twd": usd_twd
    }

def generate_playbook_with_gemini(market_data):
    print("🧠 [2/4] 調用 Google 原廠 3.6 Flash 推演今日開盤沙盤推演劇本...")
    q = market_data["quotes"]
    
    prompt = f"""你是一位對沖基金宏觀操盤總監 (Zen AI 總參謀長)。
現在是清晨 08:00，美股隔夜盤勢已結算，台股將於 09:00 開盤。請根據以下隔夜關鍵數據，產出今日台股開盤的《晨間 08:00 盤前沙盤推演劇本》：

【隔夜美股核心戰報】：
- 費城半導體 (SOX)：{q['^SOX']['price']} 點 ({q['^SOX']['change_pct']:+}%)
- 那斯達克 (IXIC)：{q['^IXIC']['price']} 點 ({q['^IXIC']['change_pct']:+}%)
- 標普 500 (S&P500)：{q['^GSPC']['price']} 點 ({q['^GSPC']['change_pct']:+}%)
- 輝達 (NVDA)：${q['NVDA']['price']} ({q['NVDA']['change_pct']:+}%)
- 蘋果 (AAPL)：${q['AAPL']['price']} ({q['AAPL']['change_pct']:+}%)

【台積電 ADR 溢價核心數據】：
- 台積電 ADR (TSM)：${q['TSM']['price']} ({q['TSM']['change_pct']:+}%)
- 美元/台幣匯率：{market_data['usd_twd']}
- ADR 換算台股等值價：{market_data['adr_equiv_twd']} 元
- 台股 2330 昨日收盤價：{market_data['tsmc_tw_close']} 元
- 💡 台積電 ADR 溢價幅度：{market_data['premium_pct']:+}%

請以俐落震撼、對沖基金操盤手專業語意輸出三大章節：
1. 🎭 【今日開盤多空劇本定調】：
   - 預估加權指數開盤跳空區間 (開高/開低幾點至幾點)。
   - 多空情境機率定調 (如：開高走高 60% / 開高震盪 30% / 開高走低 10%)。
2. ⚡ 【台積電與權值股開盤定錨】：
   - 根據 ADR 溢價幅度，推估 2330 台積電今日開盤合理點位區間與多空意圖。
   - 連帶看好的相關供應鏈板塊 (如：CoWoS設備/散熱/CPO)。
3. 🛡️ 【早盤 09:00~09:30 避震防守戒律】：
   - 早盤 15 分鐘絕不可犯之錯誤 (如：急拉不可追價之條件)。
   - 關鍵支撐防守節奏。

請嚴格使用繁體中文，格式清晰工整，直接輸出戰略文字！"""

    model_id = "gemini-3.6-flash"
    for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
        try:
            headers = {"x-goog-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
            url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
            payload = {
                "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
                "generationConfig": {"temperature": 0.25, "maxOutputTokens": 2048}
            }
            r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=25)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                content = r.json().get("candidates", [])[0]["content"]["parts"][0]["text"].strip()
                if content:
                    print(" -> 恭喜！Google 3.6 Flash 已順利產出開盤劇本！")
                    return content
        except Exception:
            continue

    return "【開盤劇本保底】隔夜費半與科技巨頭表現平穩，台指開盤預估維持平高震盪格局，建議早盤 15 分鐘觀察預估量能再行定奪。"

def broadcast_telegram_playbook(analysis_text, market_data):
    if not TG_BOT_TOKEN or not TG_CHAT_ID:
        return

    print("🚀 [3/4] 擊發 Telegram 晨間 08:00 盤前沙盤推演電報...")
    now_s = datetime.datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
    q = market_data["quotes"]
    
    sox_sign = "+" if q['^SOX']['change_pct'] > 0 else ""
    tsm_sign = "+" if q['TSM']['change_pct'] > 0 else ""
    nvda_sign = "+" if q['NVDA']['change_pct'] > 0 else ""
    prem_sign = "+" if market_data['premium_pct'] > 0 else ""

    lines = []
    lines.append("👑 <b>【Zen AI 晨間 08:00 隔夜對映 ✕ 開盤沙盤推演】</b>")
    lines.append(f"⏰ <b>發布時間</b>：<code>{now_s}</code> (開盤前 60 分鐘戰術導航)")
    lines.append("────────────────────")
    lines.append("🌐 <b>【隔夜美股與 ADR 核心結算】</b>")
    lines.append(f"• <b>費城半導體</b>：<code>{q['^SOX']['price']}</code> (<b>{sox_sign}{q['^SOX']['change_pct']}%</b>)")
    lines.append(f"• <b>輝達 (NVDA)</b>：<code>${q['NVDA']['price']}</code> (<b>{nvda_sign}{q['NVDA']['change_pct']}%</b>)")
    lines.append(f"• <b>台積電 ADR</b>：<code>${q['TSM']['price']}</code> (<b>{tsm_sign}{q['TSM']['change_pct']}%</b>)")
    lines.append(f"• 💡 <b>ADR 溢價幅度</b>：<b>{prem_sign}{market_data['premium_pct']}%</b> (等值台股 <code>{market_data['adr_equiv_twd']}元</code>)")
    lines.append("────────────────────")
    
    # 格式美化
    safe_body = html.escape(analysis_text[:3400])
    safe_body = re.sub(r'#{1,4} (.*?)\n', r'\n<b>【\1】</b>\n', safe_body)
    safe_body = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', safe_body)
    lines.append(safe_body)
    
    lines.append("────────────────────")
    lines.append(f"🌐 <b><a href=\"{WEB_REPORT_URL}\">👉 點此開啟【暗黑大屏完整開盤劇本看板】</a></b>")

    msg = "\n".join(lines)
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TG_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {"chat_id": TG_CHAT_ID, "text": msg, "parse_mode": "HTML", "disable_web_page_preview": True}
    
    try:
        r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=12)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            print(" -> Telegram 開盤劇本已成功送達長官手機！")
        else:
            payload["parse_mode"] = ""
            payload["text"] = msg[:3800]
            requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=12)
    except Exception as e:
        logger.warning(f"Telegram 推播提示: {e}")

    q = market_data["quotes"]

    cards_html = ""
    for sym in ["^SOX", "TSM", "NVDA", "^IXIC", "USDTWD=X"]:
        item = q[sym]
        color = "#22c55e" if item["change_pct"] > 0 else ("#ef4444" if item["change_pct"] < 0 else "#94a3b8")
        sign = "+" if item["change_pct"] > 0 else ""
        cards_html += f"""
        <div style="background:#0f172a; border:1px solid #1e293b; padding:15px; border-radius:8px; flex:1; min-width:160px;">
            <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:12px;">{item['name']}</div>
            <div style="color:#f8fafc; font-size:20px; font-weight:bold; margin:4px 0;">{item['price']}</div>
            <div style="color:{color}; font-size:13px; font-weight:bold;">{sign}{item['change_pct']}%</div>
        </div>
        """

    full_html = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <meta charset="utf-8">
    <title>Zen AI 晨間 08:00 盤前沙盤推演劇本</title>
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/marked/marked.min.js"></script>
    <style>
        body {{ background-color:#070a0e; color:#e2e8f0; font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,Consolas,sans-serif; padding:20px; max-width:1050px; margin:0 auto; line-height:1.6; }}
        h1, h2, h3 {{ color:#38bdf8; }}
        .header {{ background:#0c1827; border:1px solid #1e293b; padding:20px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:20px; }}
        .content-box {{ background:#111b2b; border:1px solid #1e293b; padding:25px; border-radius:10px; margin-bottom:25px; }}
        .cards-row {{ display:flex; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:20px; }}
        .adr-badge {{ background:#17152b; border:1px solid #7c3aed; padding:15px; border-radius:8px; margin-bottom:20px; }}
        .footer {{ color:#64748b; font-size:12px; text-align:center; margin-top:30px; }}
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <div class="header">
        <h1 style="margin:0 0 10px 0; font-size:24px;">👑 Zen AI 晨間 08:00 美股隔夜對映 ✕ 開盤沙盤推演</h1>
        <div style="color:#94a3b8; font-size:13px;">⚡ 時空審計時戳：{now_str} (開盤前 60 分鐘操盤總監定調)</div>
    </div>

    <div class="cards-row">
        {cards_html}
    </div>

    <div class="adr-badge">
        <span style="color:#c084fc; font-weight:bold;">💡 台積電 ADR 換算定錨：</span>
        <span style="color:#f8fafc;">折合台幣 <b>{market_data['adr_equiv_twd']} 元</b> (昨日現股收盤 {market_data['tsmc_tw_close']} 元) ✕ 溢價率：<b style="color:#22c55e;">{market_data['premium_pct']:+}%</b></span>
    </div>

    <div class="content-box">
        <div id="playbookBody">載入中...</div>
    </div>

    <div class="footer">Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.4 系統自動生成 · 機構級晨間推演核心</div>

    <script>
        const rawMarkdown = {raw_json_text};
        document.getElementById('playbookBody').innerHTML = marked.parse(rawMarkdown);
    </script>
</body>
