sql
USE [stockchangedate];
GO

-- 260. 🛡️ 3-Way 離場勝率王 (放寬至 60% 勝率實戰黃金比例)
UPDATE [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
SET [CorrectSQL] = N'/*資料庫:stockchangedate*/ TOP 100 T.* FROM ( SELECT RTRIM(B.代號) AS 代號, RTRIM(B.名稱) AS 名稱, TRY_CAST(B.成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) AS 現價, TRY_CAST(B.漲幅 AS DECIMAL(6,2)) AS [今日漲幅%], TRY_CAST(B.總量 AS INT) AS [成交量(張)], RTRIM(B.產業分類) AS 產業, CAST(CASE WHEN E.WinRate_20MA <= 1.0 THEN E.WinRate_20MA * 100.0 ELSE E.WinRate_20MA END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [20MA勝率%], CAST(E.Return_20MA AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS [20MA期望報酬%], CAST(CASE WHEN E.WinRate_10MA <= 1.0 THEN E.WinRate_10MA * 100.0 ELSE E.WinRate_10MA END AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS [10MA勝率%], RTRIM(E.OptimalExit) AS [最佳戰術均線], A.price_ma20 AS [月線20MA], ROUND(M.專家實戰總分, 2) AS 專家分 FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B JOIN ( SELECT 代號, WinRate_5MA, WinRate_10MA, WinRate_20MA, Return_20MA, OptimalExit, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(代號)) ORDER BY 更新日期 DESC) AS rn FROM StockPersonality_3Exits ) E ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(E.代號)) AND E.rn = 1 JOIN ( SELECT 代號, price_ma20, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY LTRIM(RTRIM(代號)) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn FROM allcross_live ) A ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(A.代號)) AND A.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN MasterStockAnalysis M ON LTRIM(RTRIM(B.代號)) = LTRIM(RTRIM(M.代號)) AND M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis) WHERE TRY_CAST(B.總量 AS INT) >= 600 AND TRY_CAST(B.成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) >= 15.0 AND TRY_CAST(B.成交價 AS DECIMAL(10,2)) >= A.price_ma20 AND (CASE WHEN E.WinRate_20MA <= 1.0 THEN E.WinRate_20MA * 100.0 ELSE E.WinRate_20MA END) >= 60.0 AND E.Return_20MA >= 1.0 ) T ORDER BY T.[20MA勝率%] DESC, T.[20MA期望報酬%] DESC'
WHERE [TemplateID] = 260;
GO

EXEC sp_RunQuantTemplate @ID = 260;

USE [stockchangedate];
GO

-- 260. 🛡️ 3-Way 離場勝率王 (三向PK實戰版：期望值>0 即入選，依勝率與期望報酬排序)

WHERE [TemplateID] = 260;
GO

python
# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
"""
================================================================================
👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室 Pro V16.4】10 大蒸餾頂級核武範本導出中樞 (ID 258 ~ 267)
檔案名稱：export_10_to_myword11.py
放置路徑：C:\test_c\export_10_to_myword11.py
目標檔案：
  1. C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\memory\myword_11.html
  2. C:\inetpub\wwwroot\excelimport\sqlTemplateLibrary_export.js
================================================================================
"""

import os
import sys
import html
import datetime
import pyodbc

DB_CONN_STR = 'DRIVER={SQL Server};SERVER=127.0.0.1;DATABASE=stockchangedate;Trusted_Connection=yes;'

EXPORT_HTML_PATH = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\androidapp\memory\myword_11.html"
EXPORT_JS_PATH = r"C:\inetpub\wwwroot\excelimport\sqlTemplateLibrary_export.js"

def escape_sql_for_template_literal(sql_text: str) -> str:
    if not sql_text: return ""
    return sql_text.replace("`", r"\`").replace("${", r"\${")

def export_10_distilled_templates():
    print("=" * 65)
    print("🚀 正在從 [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates] 提取 10 大蒸餾核武範本 (ID 258 ~ 267)...")
    print(f"⏰ 導出時間: {datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    print("=" * 65)

    templates = []
    with pyodbc.connect(DB_CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
        cursor = conn.cursor()
        sql = """
        SELECT TemplateID, Category, Title, StrategyDesc, CorrectSQL
        FROM [dbo].[QuantSqlTemplates]
        WHERE TemplateID BETWEEN 258 AND 267
        ORDER BY TemplateID ASC
        """
        cursor.execute(sql)
        for row in cursor.fetchall():
            templates.append({
                "id": row[0],
                "cat": str(row[1]).strip() if row[1] else "未分類",
                "title": str(row[2]).strip() if row[2] else "未命名策略",
                "desc": str(row[3]).strip() if row[3] else "",
                "sql": str(row[4]).strip() if row[4] else ""
            })

    print(f"📊 成功鎖定 {len(templates)} 組現役已驗證範本！開始生成標準 JS 物件陣列...\n")

    # 組裝標準 JS 物件陣列
    js_items = []
    for t in templates:
        cat_clean = t["cat"].replace('"', '\\"')
        title_clean = t["title"].replace('"', '\\"')
        sql_clean = t["sql"]
        
        # 確保 SQL 帶有戰略意義
        has_comment = ("戰略意義：" in sql_clean) or ("戰略意義:" in sql_clean)
        if not has_comment and t["desc"]:
            sql_clean = f"{sql_clean}\n\n/*\n戰略意義：\n{t['desc']}\n*/"

        safe_sql = escape_sql_for_template_literal(sql_clean)

        js_block = f"""  {{
    cat: "{cat_clean}",
    title: "{title_clean}",
    sql: `{safe_sql}`
  }}"""
        js_items.append(js_block)
        print(f"  [{t['id']}] [{t['cat']}] {t['title']}")

    combined_js = ",\n\n".join(js_items)

    js_file_content = f"""// ================================================================================
// 🌟 Zen AI 10 大蒸餾頂級核武量化範本庫 (ID 258 ~ 267)
// 導出時空：{datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}
// 格式規範：標準 JavaScript 物件陣列
// ================================================================================

const sqlTemplateLibrary = [
{combined_js}
];

// 雙變數相容別名
var sqlTemplates = sqlTemplateLibrary;
"""

    # 1. 寫入 myword_11.html
    html_file_content = f"""<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <title>Zen AI 10大蒸餾核武範本精選庫 (myword_11)</title>
  <style>
    body {{ background-color: #0b0e14; color: #e2e8f0; font-family: Consolas, monospace; padding: 20px; }}
    pre {{ white-space: pre-wrap; word-wrap: break-word; }}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<pre><code class="language-javascript">{html.escape(js_file_content)}</code></pre>
</body>
</html>
"""
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(EXPORT_HTML_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(EXPORT_HTML_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(html_file_content)
    print(f"\n✅ [1/2] 成功寫入 ➔ {EXPORT_HTML_PATH}")

    # 2. 寫入 sqlTemplateLibrary_export.js
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(EXPORT_JS_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    with open(EXPORT_JS_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(js_file_content)

            target_name = name
            break
    
    if not target_code:
        match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', text_clean)
        if match: target_code, target_name = match.group(1), match.group(1)

    if target_code:
        if any(k in text_clean for k in ["離場", "勝率", "出場", "賣點"]): return f"{target_code}?3", f"查詢【{target_name}】離場勝率"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["籌碼", "大戶", "集中度"]): return f"{target_code}?4", f"查詢【{target_name}】籌碼大戶動向"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["價值", "成本", "便宜"]): return f"{target_code}?2", f"查詢【{target_name}】主力成本價值區"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["分時", "轉強", "金叉", "動能"]): return f"{target_code}?1", f"查詢【{target_name}】分時轉強動能"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["圖", "截圖", "走勢"]): return f"{target_code}??", f"產出【{target_name}】四圖大滿貫"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["代號", "股號"]): return f"{target_code}?", f"鎖定【{target_name}】({target_code})"
        else: return f"{target_code}?", f"啟動【{target_name}】全知戰報"
    
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["發射", "策略", "黑馬"]): return "FIRE_STRATEGY_1", "啟動量化核武發射艙"
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["指令", "功能", "幫助", "說明", "選單"]): return "HELP", "呼叫指揮官說明書"

    return None, None

# =========================================================================
# 🗄️ 4. 資料庫查詢與 Prompt 建構
# =========================================================================
def extract_pure_code(text):
    m = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})', str(text))
    return m.group(1) if m else ""

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f: requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, timeout=3)
    except Exception: pass

def fetch_complete_stock_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    result = {}
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'")
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: result.update(dict(zip([c[0] for c in cursor.description], row)))
            
            sql_detail = """SELECT TOP 1 A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit, ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號) LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號) WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;"""
            cursor.execute(sql_detail, (clean_code, clean_code))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r: result.update({"optimal": str(r[3]), "c1": float(r[4] or 0), "osc_60m": float(r[5] or 0), "weather": str(r[6])})
    except Exception as e: print(f"⚠️ 查詢異常: {e}")
    return result if ("代號" in result or "名稱" in result) else None

def build_tactical_prompt(data, sub_mode=0):
    mode_desc = {
        0: "輸出旗艦全知戰報（含 Markdown 實戰戰術指令單表格）",
        1: "針對 60M 分時動能與當日攻防點位輸出伏兵轉強戰報",
        2: "針對 3D AMT 三維主力成本與突圍空間輸出價值區戰報",
        3: "針對 3-Way 5/10/20MA 歷史離場勝率PK與凱利風控輸出勝率戰報",
        4: "針對主力與籌碼集中度多空定性輸出籌碼戰報"
    }.get(sub_mode, "輸出全知戰報")

    return f"""你是一位頂級量化總監。請根據以下唯一真實數據庫，為【{data.get('名稱','')}({data.get('代號','')}】{mode_desc}。
嚴格禁止猜測未提供資訊，請直接針砭實戰應對策略，最後務必以「👑 總監一句話戰令：」結尾。
【量化數據庫】：
{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}"""

# =========================================================================
# 🧠 5. 四重裝甲大腦調度核心
# =========================================================================
def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    candidates = (
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] +
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]
    ) if _working_gemini_model else GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            try:
                headers = {"x-goog-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
                payload = {"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}]}
                
                r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=20)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    data = r.json()
                    cands = data.get("candidates", [])
                    if cands:
                        parts = cands[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", [])
                        content = "".join([p.get("text", "") for p in parts if "text" in p]).strip()
                        if content:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            print(f"✅ {model_name} 推論成功！(金鑰: {key[:10]}...)")
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 503:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 伺服器尖峰擁塞 (503)，秒切下一階梯隊！")
                    break
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 連線異常: {e}")
    return None, None

def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    if not OPENROUTER_API_KEY: return None, ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        try:
            headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {"model": model_id, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}], "temperature": 0.25}
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=20)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                ans = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
                if ans:
                    print(f"✅ OpenRouter ({model_name}) 備援成功！")
                    return ans, model_name
        except Exception: pass
    return None, ""

# 🌟 本地第三梯隊：Colibri 35B (Qwen 3.6 / Port 8000)
def call_colibri_local(prompt_text):
    try:
        headers = {"Content-Type": "application/json"}
        payload = {
            "model": COLIBRI_MODEL,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。請給出客觀精準的戰術建議，全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2048
        }
        r = requests.post(COLIBRI_LOCAL_URL, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=35)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            content = r.json().get("choices", [{}])[0].get("message", {}).get("content", "").strip()
            if content and len(content) > 100:
                print("✅ 🌟 本地 Colibri 35B (Qwen 3.6) 運算成功！")
                return content, "🌟 本地 Colibri 35B (Qwen 3.6)"
    except Exception as ex:
        # Colibri 離線或超時，安靜交棒給下一層
        pass
    return None, ""

# 🛡️ 本地第四梯隊：Ollama 7B (Port 11434) 保底
def call_ollama_local_fallback(prompt_text):
    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": OLLAMA_MODEL, "prompt": prompt_text, "stream": False}, timeout=15)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            ans = r.json().get("response", "").strip()
            if ans and len(ans) > 100:
                print("✅ 🛡️ 本地 Ollama (qwen2.5:7b) 保底解盤成功！")
                return ans, f"🛡️ 本地 Ollama ({OLLAMA_MODEL})"
    except Exception: pass
    return None, "離線"

def generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0):
    prompt_text = build_tactical_prompt(stock_data, sub_mode)

    # 1. 優先由 Google 原廠 3.8 / 3.6 Flash 出擊
    content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 2. 雲端備援：OpenRouter (Llama-3.3 / Qwen-2.5)
    content, model_name = call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 3. 🌟 本地升級主力：Colibri 35B (Qwen 3.6 / Port 8000)
    content, model_name = call_colibri_local(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 4. 🛡️ 本地終極保底：Ollama 7B (Port 11434)
    content, model_name = call_ollama_local_fallback(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    return "❌ 系統大腦正在調度金鑰，請稍候 10 秒重試！", "金鑰切換中"

# 📸 6. Playwright 截圖

async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, f"chart_{clean_code}_{int(time.time())}.png")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300})
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=30000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await page.evaluate("const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史')); if(btn) btn.click();")
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception: return None
        finally: await browser.close()

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = "SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0 ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;"
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            return cursor.fetchall()
    except Exception: return []

        "🤖 【Zen AI 股票戰情室 雙向操盤旗艦 V5.5】\n\n"
        "👑 【口語自然語言】：\n"

        "👑 【極速代碼火控】：\n"
        "• `2317?`  ➔ 👑 旗艦全知戰報\n"
        "• `2317?1` ➔ ⚡ 60M 伏兵轉強\n"
        "• `2317?2` ➔ 🧱 3D AMT 價值區\n"

    )
    bot.send_message(chat_id, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda msg: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    threading.Thread(target=process_message_worker, args=(message,), daemon=True).start()

def process_message_worker(message):
    try:
        if not message.text: return
        chat_id = message.chat.id
        raw_text = message.text.strip().replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!')
        
        # 🌟 NLP 智能攔截 (口語自動轉指令)
        if "?" not in raw_text and not re.search(r'\d{4,6}[bB!]', raw_text):
            parsed_cmd, reply_intent = parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text)
            if parsed_cmd:
                if parsed_cmd == "HELP":
                    send_welcome(chat_id)
                    return
                bot.send_message(chat_id, f"🗣️ [自然語言解析] 鎖定意圖: {reply_intent}\n👉 觸發指令: `{parsed_cmd}`", parse_mode="Markdown")
                raw_text = parsed_cmd
            else:
                if len(raw_text) > 2 and not raw_text.isdigit():
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 未能解析您的指令：「{raw_text}」，請確認是否包含有效股號或名稱。")
                return

        print(f"\n📩 [進入火控管線] 指令: 「{raw_text}」")

        # 🚀 發射艙指令
        if raw_text == "FIRE_STRATEGY_1":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "🚀 [指令確認] 正在背景啟動【量化範本核武發射艙】...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "quant_master_launcher.py")], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text("✅ 【發射艙】已啟動！稍後將直接把 Top 5 戰報送達本群！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 🎯 ? 60M 黑馬榜
        if raw_text == "?":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "⚡ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
            rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
            if not rows:
                bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return
            today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
            msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強黑馬榜】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
            for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
                msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]}\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
            bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
            return

        clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)
        if not clean_code: return

        # 🚀 B/! 四網齊發
        if re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*([bB!])', raw_text):
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在向 TG/LINE/FB 同步發射【{clean_code}】戰報...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "zen_broadcaster.py"), "--code", clean_code], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text(f"🚀 【{clean_code}】四網大一統廣播已發射！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 🎯 ?1~?4 全知戰報
        omni_match = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*(\?{1,2})\s*([0-9])?', raw_text)
        if omni_match:
            sub_mode = int(omni_match.group(3)) if (omni_match and omni_match.group(3)) else 0
            sub_mode_name = {0:"全知戰報", 1:"60M伏兵動能", 2:"3D AMT價值區", 3:"3-Way離場勝率", 4:"籌碼大戶集中度"}.get(sub_mode, "全知戰報")
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在調用 AI 大腦為【{clean_code}】生成【{sub_mode_name}】深度戰報...")

            stock_data = fetch_complete_stock_data(clean_code)
            if not stock_data:
                bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 查無【{clean_code}】資料庫記錄！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return

            analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode)
            clean_name = stock_data.get('名稱', '')
            full_report = f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI {sub_mode_name}\n└ 大腦: {used_brain}\n\n{analysis}"
            
            try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            except Exception: pass

            if len(full_report) > 3800:
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[:3800])
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[3800:])
            else:
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)

            send_to_line(full_report)
            return

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 處理訊息異常: {e}")

    print("=" * 70)

            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=25, long_polling_timeout=20)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

bat
@echo off
chcp 65001 >nul
title 🧠 Zen AI - Colibri 本地大腦火控啟動中樞
cd /d "K:\colibri"

echo ========================================================
echo  👑【Zen AI 股票戰情室】Colibri 本地大腦啟動中樞
echo ========================================================
echo.
echo ⏳ 正在淨化 Port 8000 殘留進程...
for /f "tokens=5" %%a in ('netstat -aon ^| findstr /R ":8000 "') do taskkill /f /pid %%a >nul 2>&1

echo.
echo 請選擇要執行的本地大腦：
echo --------------------------------------------------------
echo  [1] 啟動 Qwen 3.6 (35B) - 標準 8K 記憶 (極速省資源，推薦)
echo  [2] 啟動 Qwen 3.6 (35B) - 加大 16K 記憶 (防 400 超載版)
echo  [3] 啟動 DeepSeek V4 Flash 150B (85GB 重裝神獸)
echo  [4] 啟動 Colibri 官方引導精靈 (START-HERE)
echo --------------------------------------------------------
set /p USER_CHOICE="請輸入選項號碼 [直接按 Enter 預設為 1]: "

if "%USER_CHOICE%"=="" set USER_CHOICE=1
if "%USER_CHOICE%"=="1" goto RUN_QWEN_8K
if "%USER_CHOICE%"=="2" goto RUN_QWEN_16K
if "%USER_CHOICE%"=="3" goto RUN_DEEPSEEK
if "%USER_CHOICE%"=="4" goto RUN_START_HERE

:RUN_QWEN_8K
echo.
echo 🚀 正在啟動 Qwen 3.6 (35B) [標準 8K CTX]...
if exist "coli.cmd" (
    call coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\qwen36-35b"
) else if exist "c\coli.cmd" (
    call c\coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\qwen36-35b"
) else (
    echo 1 | call START-HERE.bat
)
goto END

:RUN_QWEN_16K
echo.
echo 🚀 正在啟動 Qwen 3.6 (35B) [加大 16K CTX - 防超載版]...
if exist "coli.cmd" (
    call coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\qwen36-35b" --ctx 16384
) else if exist "c\coli.cmd" (
    call c\coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\qwen36-35b" --ctx 16384
) else (
    call START-HERE.bat
)
goto END

:RUN_DEEPSEEK
echo.
echo 🚀 正在啟動 DeepSeek V4 Flash 150B (85GB)...
if exist "K:\colibri\models\DeepSeek-V4-Flash-reap-150b\config.json" (
    if exist "coli.cmd" (
        call coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\DeepSeek-V4-Flash-reap-150b"
    ) else (
        call c\coli.cmd web --model "K:\colibri\models\DeepSeek-V4-Flash-reap-150b"
    )
) else (
    echo ⚠️ 找不到 K:\colibri\models\DeepSeek-V4-Flash-reap-150b\config.json！
    echo 提示：請確認瀏覽器下載好的 85GB 模型檔案是否已移入該目錄。
    pause
)
goto END

:RUN_START_HERE
call START-HERE.bat
goto END

:END
pause

    "messages": [
        {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位資深台股量化操盤總監與首席技術分析師。全部使用繁體中文回覆。"},
        {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
    ],
    "temperature": 0.25,
    "max_tokens": 1500,
    "stream": False  # 🌟 核心：一次性整包回傳，絕不卡在流式握手！
}

try:

    if r.status_code == 200:

        content = data["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()

    else:
        print(f"❌ 呼叫失敗: HTTP {r.status_code} - {r.text}")

except requests.exceptions.Timeout:
    print("⏳ 連線超過 120 秒逾時！")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"⚠️ 異常: {e}")

print("=" * 65)

# 1. 量化情報層：myword_2.html 權威「專家分 ✕ 法人共振 ✕ 主力成本」
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def fetch_quant_candidates():
    print("[1/4] 啟動量化雷達，萃取 Master 核心候選標的...")
    sql = """
    SELECT TOP 10
        RTRIM(M.代號) AS 代號, 
        RTRIM(M.名稱) AS 名稱,
        ISNULL(B.成交價, 0) AS 現價, 
        ISNULL(B.漲幅, 0) AS 今日漲幅, 
        ISNULL(B.總量, 0) AS 成交量,
        RTRIM(M.產業分類) AS 產業, 
        ISNULL(B.股本億, 0) AS 股本億,
        ROUND(M.專家實戰總分, 2) AS 專家分,
        ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0) AS 外資3日,
        ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) AS 投信3日,
        ISNULL(V.本益比近四季, 0) AS 本益比,
        ISNULL(O.短線20日主力成本, 0) AS 主力成本,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(O.乖離戰術判定), N'貼近成本') AS 乖離判定,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(O.三維AMT空間判定), N'常態空間') AS 空間判定,
        ISNULL(RTRIM(M.具體概念), N'權值動能') AS 熱門題材
    FROM MasterStockAnalysis M
    JOIN stockchange.dbo.basicinfo B ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(B.代號)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 外資3日合計, 投信3日合計,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTRIM(代號) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM threemasternumber
    ) N ON RTRIM(N.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND N.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 代號, 本益比近四季,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RTRIM(代號) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) AS rn
        FROM value
    ) V ON RTRIM(V.代號) = RTRIM(M.代號) AND V.rn = 1
    LEFT JOIN View_AI_Omni_Context O ON RTRIM(M.代號) = RTRIM(O.代號) 
         AND O.資料日期 = (SELECT MAX(資料日期) FROM View_AI_Omni_Context)
    WHERE M.日期 = (SELECT MAX(日期) FROM MasterStockAnalysis)
      AND B.總量 >= 500 AND B.成交價 >= 12
      AND (ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) > 0 OR ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0) > 0)
    ORDER BY M.專家實戰總分 DESC, (ISNULL(N.投信3日合計, 0) * 2 + ISNULL(N.外資3日合計, 0)) DESC;
    """
    candidates = []
    try:
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            rows = cursor.fetchall()
            for r in rows:
                candidates.append({
                    "code": str(r[0]).strip(),
                    "name": str(r[1]).strip(),
                    "price": float(r[2]),
                    "change_pct": float(r[3]),
                    "volume": int(r[4]),
                    "industry": str(r[5]).strip(),
                    "capital": float(r[6]),
                    "expert_score": float(r[7]),
                    "foreign_3d": float(r[8]),
                    "trust_3d": float(r[9]),
                    "pe": float(r[10]),
                    "main_cost": float(r[11]),
                    "bias_status": str(r[12]).strip(),
                    "amt_space": str(r[13]).strip(),
                    "concepts": str(r[14]).strip()
                })
        print(f" -> 成功萃取 {len(candidates)} 檔具備專家分與法人動能之核心標的。")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" [!] 量化數據獲取失敗: {e}")
    return candidates

def fetch_morning_news():
    print("[2/4] 調閱宏觀焦點與產業新聞...")
    news_items = []
    
    if os.path.exists(NEWS_JSON_PATH):
        try:
            with open(NEWS_JSON_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                data = json.load(f)
                news_items = data.get("items", [])[:10]
            if news_items:
                print(f" -> 成功自快取載入 {len(news_items)} 條科技財經情報。")
                return news_items
        except Exception:
            pass

    try:
        sql = """
        SELECT TOP 5 國家區域, 指標名稱, 重要性, 影響解讀
        FROM MacroEconomicCalendar
        ORDER BY 公布日期 DESC, 重要性 DESC;
        """
        with get_db_connection() as conn:
            cur = conn.cursor()
            cur.execute(sql)
            for r in cur.fetchall():
                news_items.append({
                    "title": f"【{r[0]}】{r[1]} ({r[2]})",
                    "summary": str(r[3]).strip() if r[3] else "重大總體經濟政策指引"
                })
        if news_items:
            print(f" -> 成功自 MacroEconomicCalendar 調閱 {len(news_items)} 則總經動態。")
            return news_items
    except Exception:
        pass

    return [
        {"title": "美股AI與半導體巨頭拉升，伺服器與高頻寬記憶體需求強勁", "summary": "算力基礎建設投資持續擴張，外資主力資金集中回流高成長供應鏈。"},
        {"title": "聯準會利率政策平穩，本土投信法人展開作帳與換股操作", "summary": "低基期、貼近主力成本且技術面完成築底標的成為防禦首選。"}

def generate_chief_analysis(candidates, news_list):
    print("[3/4] AI 總參謀長啟動多重因子交叉論證大腦...")
    
    prompt = f"""
你是一位身價百億的頂級避險基金操盤總監 (Zen AI 總參謀長)。
請根據我所提供的【今日量化選股清單】與【宏觀產業情報】，進行嚴格的「雙因子共振解盤 (Quant + Macro Catalyst)」。

【今日量化多頭標的 (含主力成本、AMT空間、法人買超、專家分、具體概念)】：
{json.dumps(candidates, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

【宏觀產業與新聞情報】：
{json.dumps(news_list, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}

請輸出避險基金內部最高規格的《每日戰術作戰指令書》，結構必須包含：
1. 🎯 【大盤多空定調與風控方針】：多空位階判定、建議持股水位(%)、大盤關鍵防守節奏。
2. 🔥 【共振狙擊黑馬 (選出 2~4 檔最契合標的)】：
   - 標的名稱與代號
   - 共振理由 (結合投信/外資3日買超、專家分、具體概念與宏觀新聞題材的契合度)
   - 實戰策略 (進場防守區間、停損點位、第一/第二波段目標停利點、參考主力成本)。
3. ⚠️ 【今日盤中禁手與特情預警】：明確列出何種盤況（如早盤急拉追高、跌破主力成本線）絕對不可開倉。

請使用俐落、精闢、震撼專業的金融操盤語言直接輸出指令。
"""

    payload = {
        "contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt}]}],
        "generationConfig": {
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "maxOutputTokens": 8192
        }

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Telegram 推播 (格式轉換 ✕ 大屏直達超連結)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def broadcast_telegram(analysis_text):
    if not TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN or not TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID:
        print(" [!] Telegram 未配置 Token 或 Chat ID，略過推播。")
        return
    
    print("[4/4] 擊發 Telegram 旗艦作戰電報...")
    
    clean_text = analysis_text[:3500]
    safe_text = html.escape(clean_text)
    
    safe_text = re.sub(r'&gt; (.*?)\n', r'💡 \1\n', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'#{1,4} (.*?)\n', r'\n<b>【\1】</b>\n', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'\*\*(.*?)\*\*', r'<b>\1</b>', safe_text)
    safe_text = re.sub(r'`(.*?)`', r'<code>\1</code>', safe_text)

    now_s = datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
    msg = (
        f"👑 <b>【Zen AI 總參謀長 · 每日操盤指令單】</b>\n"
        f"🕒 <i>{now_s}</i>\n"
        f"────────────────────\n"
        f"{safe_text}\n\n"
        f"────────────────────\n"
        f"🌐 <b><a href=\"{WEB_REPORT_URL}\">👉 點此開啟【總參謀長完整戰備大屏】</a></b>"
    )
    
    url = f"https://api.telegram.org/bot{TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN}/sendMessage"
    payload = {
        "chat_id": TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID,
        "text": msg,
        "parse_mode": "HTML",
        "disable_web_page_preview": True
    }
    try:
        r = requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=15)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            print(" -> Telegram 作戰電報發射成功！")
        else:
            payload["parse_mode"] = ""
            payload["text"] = analysis_text[:3800] + f"\n\n👉 完整大屏: {WEB_REPORT_URL}"
            requests.post(url, json=payload, timeout=15)
            print(" -> Telegram 已以純文字保底成功發射！")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f" [!] Telegram 網絡請求異常: {e}")

# 主程序
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
def main():
    print("=" * 60)
    print("🚀 【Zen AI 總參謀長】深度解盤引擎出擊 (Pro V16.5)！")
    print(f"🔑 自動掛載 Gemini 神鑰: {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 | NVIDIA H100 超算: {'已就緒' if NVIDIA_API_KEY else '未配置'}")

    briefing = generate_chief_analysis(candidates, news_list)

    print("=" * 60)

if __name__ == "__main__":

# 🧠 3. 內建全市場口語化股票字典
# =========================================================================
GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT = {}

def load_global_stock_dict():
    global GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=5) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute("SELECT RTRIM(代號), RTRIM(名稱) FROM stockchange.dbo.basicinfo")
            for row in cursor.fetchall():
                code, name = str(row[0]).strip(), str(row[1]).strip()
                if len(code) <= 6:
                    GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT[name] = code
                    spoken_name = name.replace("-KY", "").replace("KY", "").replace("*", "").replace(" ", "")
                    if spoken_name != name:
                        GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT[spoken_name] = code
        print(f"✅ NLP 模組就緒：成功載入 {len(GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT)} 檔口語化股票字典！")
    except Exception as e:
        GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT = {"台積電": "2330", "鴻海": "2317", "聯發科": "2454", "創意": "3443", "奇鋐": "3017"}

load_global_stock_dict()

def parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text):
    text_clean = raw_text.replace(" ", "").upper()
    target_code, target_name = None, None

    for name in sorted(GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
        if name.upper() in text_clean:
            target_code = GLOBAL_STOCK_DICT[name]
            target_name = name
            break
    
    if not target_code:
        match = re.search(r'\b(\d{4,6})\b', text_clean)
        if match: target_code, target_name = match.group(1), match.group(1)

    if target_code:
        if any(k in text_clean for k in ["離場", "勝率", "出場", "賣點"]): return f"{target_code}?3", f"查詢【{target_name}】離場勝率"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["籌碼", "大戶", "集中度"]): return f"{target_code}?4", f"查詢【{target_name}】籌碼大戶動向"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["價值", "成本", "便宜"]): return f"{target_code}?2", f"查詢【{target_name}】主力成本價值區"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["分時", "轉強", "金叉", "動能"]): return f"{target_code}?1", f"查詢【{target_name}】分時轉強動能"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["圖", "截圖", "走勢"]): return f"{target_code}??", f"產出【{target_name}】四圖大滿貫"
        elif any(k in text_clean for k in ["代號", "股號"]): return f"{target_code}?", f"鎖定【{target_name}】({target_code})"
        else: return f"{target_code}?", f"啟動【{target_name}】全知戰報"
    
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["發射", "策略", "黑馬"]): return "FIRE_STRATEGY_1", "啟動量化核武發射艙"
    if any(k in text_clean for k in ["指令", "功能", "幫助", "說明", "選單"]): return "HELP", "呼叫指揮官說明書"

    return None, None

# =========================================================================
def extract_pure_code(text):
    m = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})', str(text))
    return m.group(1) if m else ""

def send_to_line(message_text, image_path=None):
    if not LINE_TOKEN or "請在此" in LINE_TOKEN: return
    url = "https://notify-api.line.me/api/notify"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {LINE_TOKEN}"}
    try:
        if image_path and os.path.exists(image_path):
            with open(image_path, "rb") as f: requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, files={"imageFile": f}, timeout=3)
        else:
            requests.post(url, headers=headers, data={"message": message_text}, timeout=3)
    except Exception: pass

def fetch_complete_stock_data(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    result = {}
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=8) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(f"SELECT TOP 1 * FROM [dbo].[View_AI_Omni_Context] WHERE RTRIM(代號) = '{clean_code}'")
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            if row: result.update(dict(zip([c[0] for c in cursor.description], row)))
            
            sql_detail = """SELECT TOP 1 A.代號, A.名稱, A.成交價, ISNULL(E.OptimalExit, N'🔥 20MA勝出') AS OptimalExit, ISNULL(C5.集中度1日, 0.0) AS 集中度1日, ISNULL(RAD.[60M動能(OSC)], 0.0) AS OSC_60M, ISNULL(RAD.短線氣象, N'☀️ 轉強') AS 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.allcross_live A LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.StockPersonality_3Exits E ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(E.代號) LEFT JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 代號, 集中度1日 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.Chips5 WHERE RTRIM(代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY 日期 DESC) C5 ON 1=1 LEFT JOIN stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar RAD ON RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(RAD.代號) WHERE RTRIM(A.代號) = RTRIM(?) ORDER BY A.日期 DESC;"""
            cursor.execute(sql_detail, (clean_code, clean_code))
            r = cursor.fetchone()
            if r: result.update({"optimal": str(r[3]), "c1": float(r[4] or 0), "osc_60m": float(r[5] or 0), "weather": str(r[6])})
    except Exception as e: print(f"⚠️ 查詢異常: {e}")
    return result if ("代號" in result or "名稱" in result) else None

def build_tactical_prompt(data, sub_mode=0):
    mode_desc = {
        0: "輸出旗艦全知戰報（含 Markdown 實戰戰術指令單表格）",
        1: "針對 60M 分時動能與當日攻防點位輸出伏兵轉強戰報",
        2: "針對 3D AMT 三維主力成本與突圍空間輸出價值區戰報",
        3: "針對 3-Way 5/10/20MA 歷史離場勝率PK與凱利風控輸出勝率戰報",
        4: "針對主力與籌碼集中度多空定性輸出籌碼戰報"
    }.get(sub_mode, "輸出全知戰報")

    return f"""你是一位頂級量化總監。請根據以下唯一真實數據庫，為【{data.get('名稱','')}({data.get('代號','')}】{mode_desc}。
嚴格禁止猜測未提供資訊，請直接針砭實戰應對策略，最後務必以「👑 總監一句話戰令：」結尾。
【量化數據庫】：
{json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)}"""

# =========================================================================
# 🧠 5. 四重裝甲大腦調度核心 (Google ➔ NVIDIA H100 ➔ OpenRouter ➔ 本地)
# =========================================================================
def call_gemini_official(prompt_text):
    global _working_gemini_model
    candidates = (
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] == _working_gemini_model] +
        [c for c in GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES if c[0] != _working_gemini_model]
    ) if _working_gemini_model else GEMINI_MODEL_CANDIDATES

    for model_id, model_name in candidates:
        for key in GEMINI_API_KEYS:
            try:
                headers = {"x-goog-api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}
                url = f"https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{model_id}:generateContent"
                payload = {"contents": [{"parts": [{"text": prompt_text}]}]}
                
                r = requests.post(url, json=payload, headers=headers, timeout=20)
                if r.status_code == 200:
                    data = r.json()
                    cands = data.get("candidates", [])
                    if cands:
                        parts = cands[0].get("content", {}).get("parts", [])
                        content = "".join([p.get("text", "") for p in parts if "text" in p]).strip()
                        if content:
                            _working_gemini_model = model_id
                            print(f"✅ {model_name} 推論成功！(金鑰: {key[:10]}...)")
                            return content, model_name
                elif r.status_code == 503:
                    print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 伺服器尖峰擁塞 (503)，秒切下一階梯隊！")
                    break
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"⚠️ {model_name} 連線異常: {e}")
    return None, None

# 🌟 梯隊二：NVIDIA Build (H100 滿血 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)
def call_nvidia_nim(prompt_text):
    if not NVIDIA_API_KEY: return None, ""
    try:
        headers = {
            "Authorization": f"Bearer {NVIDIA_API_KEY.strip()}",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        }
        payload = {
            "model": NVIDIA_MODEL,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "你是一位頂級台股量化操盤總監。一律使用繁體中文回覆。"},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}
            ],
            "temperature": 0.25,
            "max_tokens": 2048
        }
        t0 = time.time()
        r = requests.post(NVIDIA_NIM_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=25)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            ans = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
            if ans and len(ans) > 80:
                elapsed = round(time.time() - t0, 1)
                print(f"✅ 🌟 NVIDIA Build H100 (DeepSeek V4.1) 運算成功！(耗時 {elapsed}s)")
                return ans, "🌟 NVIDIA Build H100 (DeepSeek V4.1)"
    except Exception as ex:
        print(f"⚠️ NVIDIA NIM 呼叫提示: {ex}")
    return None, ""

# 梯隊三：OpenRouter 雲端備援
def call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text):
    if not OPENROUTER_API_KEY: return None, ""
    for model_id, model_name in OPENROUTER_MODEL_TIERS:
        try:
            headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {OPENROUTER_API_KEY}", "Content-Type": "application/json"}
            payload = {"model": model_id, "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": prompt_text}], "temperature": 0.25}
            r = requests.post(OPENROUTER_URL, headers=headers, json=payload, timeout=20)
            if r.status_code == 200:
                ans = r.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"].strip()
                if ans:
                    print(f"✅ OpenRouter ({model_name}) 備援成功！")
                    return ans, model_name
        except Exception: pass
    return None, ""

# 梯隊四：本地保底大腦
def call_ollama_local_fallback(prompt_text):
    try:
        r = requests.post(OLLAMA_URL, json={"model": OLLAMA_MODEL, "prompt": prompt_text, "stream": False}, timeout=15)
        if r.status_code == 200:
            ans = r.json().get("response", "").strip()
            if ans and len(ans) > 100:
                print("✅ 🛡️ 本地 Ollama (qwen2.5:7b) 保底成功！")
                return ans, f"🛡️ 本地 Ollama ({OLLAMA_MODEL})"
    except Exception: pass
    return None, "離線"

def generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode=0):
    prompt_text = build_tactical_prompt(stock_data, sub_mode)

    # 1. 第一梯隊：Google 原廠 3.8 / 3.6 Flash (極速秒出)
    content, model_name = call_gemini_official(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 2. 🌟 第二梯隊：NVIDIA Build H100 (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 滿血超算)
    content, model_name = call_nvidia_nim(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 3. 第三梯隊：OpenRouter 雲端備援
    content, model_name = call_openrouter_fallback(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    # 4. 第四梯隊：本地 Ollama 實體保底
    content, model_name = call_ollama_local_fallback(prompt_text)
    if content: return content, model_name

    return "❌ 系統大腦正在調度金鑰，請稍候 10 秒重試！", "金鑰切換中"

# =========================================================================
# 📸 6. Playwright 截圖
# =========================================================================
async def capture_stock_chart(stock_code):
    clean_code = extract_pure_code(stock_code)
    url = f"https://zen2965.duckdns.org:8888/excelimport/excelsql2.html?stock={clean_code}"
    output_path = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, f"chart_{clean_code}_{int(time.time())}.png")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page(viewport={"width": 1400, "height": 1300})
        try:
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=30000)
            await asyncio.sleep(2)
            await page.evaluate("const btn = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('button')).find(el => el.textContent.includes('歷史')); if(btn) btn.click();")
            await asyncio.sleep(3)
            await page.screenshot(path=output_path, full_page=True)
            return output_path
        except Exception: return None
        finally: await browser.close()

def query_kd_cross_stocks():
    sql = "SELECT TOP 10 代號, 名稱, 分組, 策略靈魂, ROUND([60M動能(OSC)], 2) AS [60M_OSC], ROUND([60M_K值], 1) AS [60M_K], 日線分, 短線氣象 FROM stockchangedate.dbo.View_AI_Elite_Radar WHERE [短線氣象] LIKE N'%轉強%' OR [60M動能(OSC)] > 5.0 ORDER BY [60M動能(OSC)] DESC, 日線分 DESC;"
    try:
        with pyodbc.connect(CONN_STR, timeout=10) as conn:
            cursor = conn.cursor()
            cursor.execute(sql)
            return cursor.fetchall()
    except Exception: return []

    )
    bot.send_message(chat_id, welcome_text, parse_mode='Markdown')

@bot.message_handler(func=lambda msg: True)
def handle_all_messages(message):
    threading.Thread(target=process_message_worker, args=(message,), daemon=True).start()

def process_message_worker(message):
    try:
        if not message.text: return
        chat_id = message.chat.id
        raw_text = message.text.strip().replace('？', '?').replace('！', '!')
        
        # 🌟 NLP 智能攔截 (口語自動轉指令)
        if "?" not in raw_text and not re.search(r'\d{4,6}[bB!]', raw_text) and not any(k in raw_text for k in ["說明", "圖"]):
            parsed_cmd, reply_intent = parse_natural_language_intent(raw_text)
            if parsed_cmd:
                if parsed_cmd == "HELP":
                    send_welcome(chat_id)
                    return
                bot.send_message(chat_id, f"🗣️ [自然語言解析] 鎖定意圖: {reply_intent}\n👉 觸發指令: `{parsed_cmd}`", parse_mode="Markdown")
                raw_text = parsed_cmd
            else:
                if len(raw_text) > 2 and not raw_text.isdigit():
                    bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 未能解析您的指令：「{raw_text}」，請確認是否包含有效股號或名稱。")
                return

        print(f"\n📩 [進入火控管線] 指令: 「{raw_text}」")

        # 🚀 發射艙指令
        if raw_text == "FIRE_STRATEGY_1":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "🚀 [指令確認] 正在背景啟動【量化範本核武發射艙】...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "quant_master_launcher.py")], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text("✅ 【發射艙】已啟動！稍後將直接把 Top 5 戰報送達本群！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 🎯 ? 60M 黑馬榜
        if raw_text == "?":
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, "⚡ 正在掃描全市場 60M 轉強伏兵黑馬...")
            rows = query_kd_cross_stocks()
            if not rows:
                bot.edit_message_text("⚠️ 目前無符合 60M 轉強之金叉標的。", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return
            today_str = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y/%m/%d')
            msg = f"⚡ 【Zen AI 60M 低檔轉強黑馬榜】\n📅 日期：{today_str}\n────────────────────────\n"
            for idx, r in enumerate(rows, 1):
                msg += f"{idx}. 🌟 {r[0]} {r[1]}\n   ├─ 60M OSC: `+{r[4]}` | K值: `{r[5]}`\n   ├─ 氣象: 【{r[7]}】 | 總分: `+{r[6]}分`\n   └─ 題材: 【{r[3]}】\n"
            bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            bot.send_message(chat_id, msg)
            return

        clean_code = extract_pure_code(raw_text)
        if not clean_code: return

        # 🚀 B/! 四網齊發
        if re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*([bB!])', raw_text):
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在向 TG/LINE/FB 同步發射【{clean_code}】戰報...")
            subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-u", os.path.join(SCRIPT_DIR, "zen_broadcaster.py"), "--code", clean_code], cwd=SCRIPT_DIR)
            bot.edit_message_text(f"🚀 【{clean_code}】四網大一統廣播已發射！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            return

        # 📸 圖表推送 (P 或 含「圖」字)
        if raw_text.lower().endswith("p") or (raw_text.endswith("圖") and not raw_text.endswith("全知圖")):
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📸 正在為【{clean_code}】產出四大聯動圖表高清截圖...")
            photo_path = None
            try: photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
            except Exception: pass
            try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            except Exception: pass
            if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: bot.send_photo(chat_id, f)
                send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code}】四大圖表", photo_path)
            else:
                bot.send_message(chat_id, f"⚠️ 【{clean_code}】截圖生成異常。")
            return

        # 🎯 ?1~?4 全知戰報 (含說明R、說明)
        omni_match = re.search(r'([0-9]{4,6})\s*(\?{1,2})\s*([0-9])?', raw_text)
        is_legacy_explain = "說明" in raw_text

        if omni_match or is_legacy_explain:
            is_with_photo = (omni_match and omni_match.group(2) == "??") or ("全知圖" in raw_text) or raw_text.endswith("說明R")
            sub_mode = int(omni_match.group(3)) if (omni_match and omni_match.group(3)) else 0
            sub_mode_name = {0:"全知戰報", 1:"60M伏兵動能", 2:"3D AMT價值區", 3:"3-Way離場勝率", 4:"籌碼大戶集中度"}.get(sub_mode, "全知戰報")
            wait_msg = bot.send_message(chat_id, f"📡 正在調用 AI 大腦為【{clean_code}】生成【{sub_mode_name}】深度戰報...")

            stock_data = fetch_complete_stock_data(clean_code)
            if not stock_data:
                bot.edit_message_text(f"❌ 查無【{clean_code}】資料庫記錄！", chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
                return

            analysis, used_brain = generate_tactical_analysis(stock_data, sub_mode)
            clean_name = stock_data.get('名稱', '')
            full_report = f"🎯 【{clean_name} ({clean_code})】 Zen AI {sub_mode_name}\n└ 大腦: {used_brain}\n\n{analysis}"
            
            try: bot.delete_message(chat_id, wait_msg.message_id)
            except Exception: pass

            if len(full_report) > 3800:
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[:3800])
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report[3800:])
            else:
                bot.send_message(chat_id, full_report)

            send_to_line(full_report)

            if is_with_photo:
                time.sleep(0.3)
                try:
                    photo_path = asyncio.run(capture_stock_chart(clean_code))
                    if photo_path and os.path.exists(photo_path):
                        with open(photo_path, 'rb') as f: bot.send_photo(chat_id, f)
                        send_to_line(f"📊 【{clean_code} {clean_name}】四大圖表", photo_path)
                except Exception: pass
            return

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ 處理訊息異常: {e}")

    print("=" * 70)
    print("🤖 【Zen AI Telegram 雙向操盤機器人 Flagship V5.6】啟動！")
    print(f"🔑 自動掛載 Gemini 神鑰: {len(GEMINI_API_KEYS)} 組 | NVIDIA H100 超算: {'已就緒' if NVIDIA_API_KEY else '未配置'}")

    while True:
        try:
            bot.infinity_polling(timeout=25, long_polling_timeout=20)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"⚠️ 連線重試中: {e}")
            time.sleep(3)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
